Abstract: 3D change detection from multi-view images is essential for urban monitoring, disaster assessment, and autonomous driving. However, existing methods predominantly operate in the 2D domain, where viewpoint variations are mistaken for physical changes and depth is unavailable. While visual geometry foundation models like VGGT rapidly produce dense point clouds from unposed images, independent per-epoch reconstruction encounters fundamental obstacles: unpredictable inter-epoch scale ambiguity, registration-change paradox where scene changes corrupt alignment, and pervasive edge-flying noise. To address these challenges, we present VGGT-CD, a training-free pipeline decoupling cross-temporal registration from dynamic-change interference. In the Coarse Stage, sparse keyframe joint inference establishes a unified metric space and yields an initial Sim(3) prior. In the Fine Stage, dense reconstructions are purified by isolating static-background correspondences. A closed-form centroid alignment refines the translation while locking scale and rotation, using a residual self-check to mathematically guarantee non-degradation. Evaluated on an 11-scene benchmark from the World Across Time dataset, VGGT-CD reduces Absolute Trajectory Error by 44% outdoors and 59% indoors. It completes registration over 6 times faster, producing high-purity 3D change maps without task-specific training.

</details>


### [90] [Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16861)
*Mingxu Chai,Ziyu Shen,Chenyu Liu,Kaidi Zhang,Jiazheng Zhang,Dingwei Zhu,Zhiheng Xi,Ruoyu Chen,Jun Long,Jihua Kang,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出前缀自适应块扩散模型(PA-BDM)，用因果去噪替代双向去噪，将块大小作为最大候选范围而非固定提交单位，通过置信门控结构损失和渐进式前缀提交机制实现高效文档解析，3B模型在多个基准上取得更高识别分数，推理吞吐量比2.5B MinerU-Diffusion提升71.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块扩散模型(BDM)在文档解析中存在两个关键问题：1）去噪和缓存提交被绑定在固定块边界上，块内去噪导致并行性收缩，且生成的token必须等待整个块完成后才能缓存；2）块内双向去噪与块间自回归产生冲突，造成信息流不一致，影响对结构敏感的识别任务。

Method: 1）用从前缀到后缀的因果去噪替代块内双向去噪；2）将块大小视为最大候选范围而非固定提交单元；3）提出置信门控结构损失(CSL)，在扩展到更长连续训练之前构建低熵前缀；4）推理时使用渐进式前缀提交(PPC)，动态将最长的可靠前缀提交到KV缓存中，并从更新后的前缀重置下一个候选范围。

Result: 3B参数规模的PA-BDM在多个基准上取得更高的识别分数，推理吞吐量比2.5B MinerU-Diffusion提升71.6%。

Conclusion: PA-BDM通过解耦块边界与去噪/缓存提交的绑定，解决了现有BDM在并行性和信息流一致性上的矛盾，显著提升了文档解析的性能和效率。

Abstract: Block Diffusion Models (BDMs) support parallel generation, flexible-length output, and KV caching, making them promising for efficient document parsing. However, existing BDMs bind denoising and cache commitment to fixed block boundaries: parallelism shrinks during intra-block denoising, while generated tokens cannot be cached until the whole block is completed. Moreover, intra-block bidirectional denoising conflicts with inter-block autoregression, creating inconsistent information flow that can challenge structure-sensitive recognition. We propose the Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion Model (PA-BDM), which replaces intra-block bidirectional denoising with causal denoising from prefix to suffix and treats the block size as a maximum candidate range rather than a fixed commitment unit. PA-BDM uses Confidence-gated Structural Loss (CSL) to build low-entropy prefixes before extending training to longer continuations. During inference, Progressive Prefix Commitment (PPC) then dynamically commits the longest reliable prefix into the KV cache and resets the next candidate range from the updated prefix, restoring a large parallel decoding space at each step. Experiments show that the 3B PA-BDM achieves higher recognition scores on several benchmarks and improves inference throughput by 71.6\% over the 2.5B MinerU-Diffusion.

</details>


### [91] [Metric-Guided Feature Fusion of Visual Foundation Models for Segmentation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16864)
*Yachan Guo,JoseLuis Gomez Zurita,Danna Xue,Yi Xiao,AntonioManuel Lopez Pena*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于无标签度量（结构一致性与边缘保真度）的引导方法，用于选取和融合不同视觉基础模型（如SAM2、DINOv3）的互补特征，以提升密集预测任务性能，无需复杂架构改动且仅需单阶段训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉基础模型在密集预测任务中表现不佳，且不同模型存在表征偏差（如SAM2关注细粒度边界，DINOv3强调物体结构），简单的多模型融合缺乏可解释的指导原则，难以获得可靠收益。

Method: 设计两套无标签度量（结构一致性、边缘保真度）评估VFM编码器特征，据此选取互补的边缘强/结构强编码器对，通过主-辅助融合方案进行特征集成，无需复杂架构修改，仅需单阶段训练。

Result: 在多个密集预测任务上，与基线相比取得一致性能提升，具备更好的物体级语义和更精确的边界定位。

Conclusion: 基于度量引导的VFM互补特征融合策略有效且可解释，为多模型融合提供了原则性指导，在密集预测任务中具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Although large-scale visual foundation models (VFMs) achieve remarkable performance in semantic understanding, they still underperform in instance-aware dense prediction tasks. They exhibit different biases in representation: for instance, promptable segmentation models (e.g., SAM2) focus on fine-grained region boundaries, while self-supervised models (e.g., DINOv3) emphasize object-level structure. This observation highlights the potential of combining complementary features from different VFMs to enhance downstream dense prediction tasks. However, naive multi-VFM fusion seldom leads to reliable gains, and interpretable principles for leveraging their complementary features are still underexplored. In this work, we propose a metric-guided approach that effectively selects and aggregates complementary features from different VFMs based on explicit assessment scores. Specifically, we design a suite of label-free metrics in feature space across two aspects, Structural Coherence and Edge Fidelity, to assess features of VFM encoders. Guided by these scores, we identify complementary edge-strong and structure-strong encoder pairs, and integrate them via a master-auxiliary fusion scheme. This feature fusion requires no complex architectural changes and is trained only in a single stage. Our model shows consistent performance gains across multiple dense prediction tasks compared with the baselines, with better object-level semantics and more accurately localized boundaries. The code is available at {https://github.com/gyc-code/metric-guided-fusion}.

</details>


### [92] [HAD: Hallucination-Aware Diffusion Priors for 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16873)
*Xi Liu,Weiwei Sun,Zhou Ren,Chris Broaddus,Siyu Huang,Laurent Guigues*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HAD（幻觉感知扩散先验），通过估计像素级幻觉分数图，选择性屏蔽扩散模型增强视图中的不可靠像素，有效减少稀疏视角3D重建中的幻觉伪影，实现了多基准上最优的新视角合成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散先验在稀疏视角3D重建中虽能增强视图质量，但会引入与输入视图不一致的幻觉伪影（hallucinated artifacts），影响最终3D模型的真实性。解决这一挑战是本文的核心动机。

Method: 1) 利用在大规模3D数据上预训练的前馈新视角合成网络，估算增强图像的逐像素幻觉分数图；2) 在渐进式3D重建过程中，根据幻觉分数对不可靠像素进行选择性掩码，阻止伪影引入；3) 对同一新视角，基于不同输入视图生成多个增强版本并融合，利用全局上下文信息提升质量。

Result: HAD显著减少了扩散辅助3D重建中的幻觉伪影，在多个基准的新视角合成任务上达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 通过幻觉感知的掩码策略，HAD有效解决了扩散先验在3D重建中引入不一致伪影的问题，为扩散模型辅助的3D重建提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Diffusion priors have recently demonstrated strong capability in enhancing the quality of sparse-view 3D reconstruction by augmenting training views at novel viewpoints, but they inevitably introduce hallucinated content -- artifacts inconsistent with the input views -- into the final 3D model. To address this challenge, we propose Hallucination-Aware Diffusion prior (HAD), which estimates pixel-wise hallucination score maps for augmented images by leveraging multi-view reasoning capabilities from a feedforward novel view synthesis (NVS) network pre-trained on large-scale 3D data. These hallucination scores enable selective masking of unreliable pixels during the progressive 3D reconstruction procedure, preventing the introduction of non-existent artifacts into the 3D model. To further enhance performance, we create multiple versions of augmented images at each novel view by conditioning the diffusion prior on different input views, which are then fused into a final image that leverages the broader context across all input views. We show that our method substantially reduces hallucination artifacts in diffusion-assisted 3D reconstruction, thereby achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks on novel view synthesis. Our project are publicly available at \href{https://xiliu8006.github.io/HAD-Project-website/}{project website}.

</details>


### [93] [Zero-Shot Faithful Textual Explanations via Directional-Derivative Influence on Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16877)
*Toshinori Yamauchi,Hiroshi Kera,Kazuhiko Kawamoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FaithTrace提出了一种通过计算类别logit沿文本诱导方向的方向导数来衡量解释忠实性的方法，生成比现有方法更忠实的零样本文本解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本文本解释方法常常遗漏真正驱动预测的特征，导致解释对模型决策证据的忠实性有限。

Method: 提出影响分数（influence score），即类别logit在分类器特征空间中沿文本诱导方向的方向导数，作为忠实性的代理指标；并将该分数扩展为定量评估指标。

Result: 实验表明FaithTrace生成的解释比基线方法更忠实，有助于更准确地理解模型。

Conclusion: FaithTrace通过直接度量解释所诱导的表征对类别logit的影响，有效提升了零样本文本解释的忠实性，并弥补了忠实性评估指标的缺失。

Abstract: Zero-shot textual explanations aim to make image classifiers more transparent by probing their internal representations, without relying on task-specific supervision or LVLMs. However, existing methods often miss the features that truly drive the prediction, resulting in limited \textit{faithfulness} to the evidence underlying the model's decision. To address this, we propose FaithTrace. Motivated by the idea that faithful explanations should describe concepts that strongly influence the prediction, FaithTrace directly measures how much the representation induced by the explanation changes the class logit. We introduce an influence score, computed as the directional derivative of the class logit along the text-induced direction in the classifier's feature space, and use it as a proxy for faithfulness. Moreover, we extend this influence score into quantitative evaluation metrics, helping fill the gap in faithfulness evaluation for textual explanations. Experiments show that FaithTrace yields more faithful explanations than baselines, facilitating a more accurate understanding of the model. The code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [94] [Towards Generalized Image Manipulation Localization via Score-based Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16879)
*Yunfei Wang,Bo Du,Zhe Yang,Xin Liu,Zhiyu Lin,Tianxin Xu,Ji-Zhe Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffIML是一个基于分数生成建模的图像篡改定位框架，通过近似分数函数而非学习硬决策边界来提升泛化能力，在8个非生成和3个生成基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像篡改定位判别方法学习固定决策边界，容易过拟合特定训练伪影，无法泛化到未见过的篡改类型。

Method: 提出DiffIML框架：1) 用分数生成建模近似分数函数（对数似然的梯度）来捕获掩码分布的内在几何拓扑；2) 轻量级VAE实现快速潜在空间处理；3) 解耦架构+轻量去噪UNet；4) 边缘监督+错误先验缓解采样误差累积。

Result: 在8个非生成和3个生成基准数据集上，DiffIML持续优于SOTA方法，在未见过的数据集上表现出显著的泛化提升。

Conclusion: 扩散模型可作为所学分数函数的有效数值求解器，为图像篡改定位提供了一种克服判别模型脆弱性的新范式。

Abstract: With the rapid evolution of synthetic media, Image Manipulation Localization (IML) has emerged as a critical component in multimedia forensics for ensuring the integrity of digital content. However, generalization remains a core challenge, as existing discriminative methods typically learn a fixed decision boundary that tends to overfit to specific training artifacts and fails to adapt to unseen manipulation types. To address this, we propose DiffIML, a novel framework that introduces score-based generative modeling to IML. Diverging from the direct estimation of hard boundaries, DiffIML approximates the score function, the gradient of the log-likelihood, to capture the intrinsic geometric topology of mask distributions. This paradigm leverages structural priors to iteratively recover coherent masks from noise, thereby circumventing the brittleness associated with discriminative models. Under this formulation, diffusion models serve as an effective numerical solver for the learned score function.To ensure practicality, we respectively resolve the efficiency and stability bottlenecks of standard diffusion by: (1) utilizing a Lightweight Mask-Specific VAE for fast latent-space process and a decoupled architecture with a lightweight denoising UNet, (2) edge supervision and error prior to mitigate error accumulation during sampling. Extensive experiments of two distinct protocols on eight non-generative and three generative benchmarks demonstrate that DiffIML consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding remarkable generalization improvements on diverse unseen datasets. The code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [95] [Mind the Gap: Learning Modality-Agnostic Representations with a Cross-Modality UNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16887)
*Xin Niu,Enyi Li,Jinchao Liu,Yan Wang,Margarita Osadchy,Yongchun Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为MarrNet的跨模态识别方法，核心是紧凑的编码器-解码器模块cmUNet，通过跨模态变换和模态内重建学习模态无关表示，并结合对抗/感知损失保持身份信息。在五个任务（拉曼-红外光谱匹配、跨模态行人重识别、异质人脸识别）上超越SOTA，并发现遮挡鲁棒性可作为衡量跨模态方法泛化能力的指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态方法存在两个主要问题：(1) 缩小分布差异或学习不可区分表示的方法会丢失判别信息；(2) 显式模态转换方法在转换困难时性能急剧下降。因此需要一种能同时保持身份信息又去除模态特异性信息的方法。

Method: 提出cmUNet紧凑编码器-解码器模块，通过两个目标学习模态无关表示：跨模态变换（将一种模态映射到另一种）和模态内重建（保持身份信息），并用对抗/感知损失增强表示在原始样本空间中的不可区分性。将cmUNet连接到标准特征提取网络形成MarrNet，输出相似度得分进行匹配。

Result: 在拉曼-红外光谱匹配、跨模态行人重识别、照片-素描/可见光-近红外/可见光-热成像异质人脸识别五个任务上，MarrNet均优于现有方法。实验还发现跨模态方法可能从局部或错误区域提取判别信息导致泛化差，而遮挡鲁棒性可作为衡量能否弥合模态差距的指标。

Conclusion: MarrNet通过cmUNet模块有效解决了跨模态识别中判别信息丢失与模态转换困难的两难问题，在多种跨模态任务上表现出色。遮挡鲁棒性分析为评估跨模态方法的泛化能力提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Cross-modality recognition has many important applications in science, law enforcement and entertainment. Popular methods to bridge the modality gap include reducing the distributional differences of representations of different modalities, learning indistinguishable representations or explicit modality transfer. The first two approaches suffer from the loss of discriminant information while removing the modality-specific variations. The third one heavily relies on the successful modality transfer, could face catastrophic performance drop when explicit modality transfers are not possible or difficult. To tackle this problem, we proposed a compact encoder-decoder neural module (cmUNet) to learn modality-agnostic representations while retaining identity-related information. This is achieved through cross-modality transformation and in-modality reconstruction, enhanced by an adversarial/perceptual loss which encourages indistinguishability of representations in the original sample space. For cross-modality matching, we propose MarrNet where cmUNet is connected to a standard feature extraction network which takes as inputs the modality-agnostic representations and outputs similarity scores for matching. We validated our method on five challenging tasks, namely Raman-infrared spectrum matching, cross-modality person re-identification and heterogeneous (photo-sketch, visible-near infrared and visible-thermal) face recognition, where MarrNet showed superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, it is observed that a cross-modality matching method could be biased to extract discriminant information from partial or even wrong regions, due to incompetence of dealing with modality gaps, which subsequently leads to poor generalization. We show that robustness to occlusions can be an indicator of whether a method can well bridge the modality gap.

</details>


### [96] [Controlling Decision Drift in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16889)
*Chenglizhao Chen,Yuchen Cao,Xinyu Liu,Mengke Song,Guisheng Zhang,Xiaomin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两层级参考对齐框架，通过特征表示和决策层级的稳定参考，解决多模态情感分析中模态缺失和质量不平衡问题，在CMU-MOSI/MOSEI上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在模态缺失时生成的特征偏离真实分布；不可靠模态主导融合导致表示偏移和情感表示不稳定。

Method: 两层级参考对齐框架：第一层用完整模态样本约束表示，将不同模态组合对齐到共享情感空间；第二层通过原型检索和投票抑制不可靠模态，强制决策层级的跨模态一致性。

Result: CMU-MOSI上ACC 86.28%, F1 86.24%；CMU-MOSEI上ACC 85.88%, F1 85.86%，在各种模态缺失设置下均有一致提升。

Conclusion: 所提框架能有效提升模态缺失场景下情感分析的稳定性和可靠性，在完整模态输入下也达到SOTA性能。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis relies on textual, acoustic, and visual signals, yet real-world data often suffer from modality missing and quality imbalance. Existing methods generate features for modality missing from available ones, but differences in expression mechanisms and sentiment dynamics across modalities may cause the generated features to deviate from true distributions and mislead prediction. In addition, unreliable modalities may dominate fusion, resulting in representation shift across modality combinations and unstable sentiment representations. To address these challenges, we propose a two-level reference alignment framework. The framework introduces stable references at the feature representation and sentiment decision levels to improve robustness under modality missing. First-level reference alignment leverages complete-modality samples to constrain representations and align different modality combinations into a shared sentiment space. Second-level reference alignment enforces cross-modal consistency at the decision level by suppressing unreliable modalities through prototype retrieval and voting. As a result, the framework maintains stable and reliable sentiment predictions under diverse missing-modality patterns. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI show consistent improvements across various missing-modality settings. Under full-modality input, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ACC of 86.28% and 85.88%, and F1 of 86.24% and 85.86%.

</details>


### [97] [DriveSafe: A Framework for Risk Detection and Safety Suggestions in Driving Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16892)
*Sainithin Artham,Shankar Gangisetty,Avijit Dasgupta,C. V. Jawahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveSafe提出了一种基于结构化自然语言描述的自动驾驶风险感知框架，通过生成空间定位的图文描述并微调轻量级适配器模块，在DRAMA基准上取得了最优性能，显著超越零样本MLLM和领域专用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本多模态大语言模型在细粒度、空间定位的风险评估任务中仍不如领域专用方法，因此需要一种能有效注入领域知识的框架来提升自动驾驶场景下的风险感知能力。

Method: 首先生成包含运动、空间和深度线索的空间定位图文描述，再基于这些描述进行下游风险评估（识别危险物体、位置及不安全行为），最后通过图文-风险配对微调轻量级适配器模块，将领域知识注入基础大语言模型。

Result: 在DRAMA基准上取得最先进性能，消融实验验证了各关键设计选择的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将风险评估建立在显式的语言场景描述上，DriveSafe有效弥合了零样本MLLM与领域专用方法之间的差距，为自动驾驶安全关键环境下的综合态势感知提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Comprehensive situational awareness is essential for autonomous vehicles operating in safety-critical environments, as it enables the identification and mitigation of potential risks. Although recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise on general vision-language tasks, our findings indicate that zero-shot MLLMs still underperform compared to domain-specific methods in fine-grained, spatially grounded risk assessment. To address this gap, we propose DriveSafe, a framework for risk-aware scene understanding that leverages structured natural language descriptions. Specifically, our method first generates spatially grounded captions enriched with multimodal context, including motion, spatial, and depth cues. These captions are then used for downstream risk assessment, explicitly identifying hazardous objects, their locations, and the unsafe behaviors they imply, followed by actionable safety suggestions. To further improve performance, we employ caption-risk pairings to fine-tune a lightweight adapter module, efficiently injecting domain-specific knowledge into the base LLM. By conditioning risk assessment on explicit language-based scene representations, DriveSafe achieves significant gains over both zero-shot MLLMs and prior domain-specific baselines. Exhaustive experiments on the DRAMA benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our key design choices. Project page: https://cvit.iiit.ac.in/ research/projects/cvit-projects/drivesafe

</details>


### [98] [LASAR: Towards Spatio-temporal Reasoning with Latent Cognitive Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16899)
*Jinzhou Tang,Sidi Liu,Waikit Xiu,Weixing Chen,Keze Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LASAR架构（双记忆系统）和ST-CRL对比学习目标，通过时空上下文认知查询训练智能体构建内部认知地图，在VLN-CE和VSI-Bench基准上实现2%-3.5%的零样本泛化提升，且认知地图具有高自一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身AI方法（如VLN、EQA）缺乏迫使模型编码细粒度空间关系（拓扑、距离）的学习信号，智能体可能只是模仿专家轨迹而非真正构建内部空间结构模型。

Method: 提出LASAR双记忆系统架构（情景记忆+语义认知地图），配合ST-CRL对比学习目标，利用模拟环境中带注释的时空上下文生成认知查询，构建样本对来训练智能体形成内部认知地图。

Result: 在VLN-CE和VSI-Bench基准上实现2%-3.5%的零样本泛化性能提升，且认知地图具有高自一致性。

Conclusion: 通过强制编码时空上下文信息，智能体能够真正构建内部空间结构模型，而非单纯模仿专家轨迹，从而提升跨场景泛化能力。

Abstract: A fundamental challenge in embodied AI is verifying if agents build internal models of spatial structure or merely learn to mimic task-specific expert trajectories. This is critical as foundational approaches rooted in action-centric tasks (e.g., VLN) and reasoning-centric tasks (e.g., EQA) often share a common limitation: they lack a learning signal that forces them to encode fine-grained spatial relationships (like topology or distance) over long-range, fragmented experiences. To address this, we first propose LASAR, an architecture featuring a dual-memory system designed to maintain both episodic experiences and a semantic cognitive map. We then introduce Spatio-temporal Contextual Representation Learning (ST-CRL), a contrastive objective designed to train this architecture. ST-CRL leverages spatio-temporal cues from cognitive queries generated through annotated spatio-temporal context in simulation to build sample pairs, thereby forming the internal cognitive map from the agent's experiences. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves 2\%-3.5\% gains in both zero-shot generalization on standard VLN-CE and VSI-Bench benchmarks. We also demonstrate that our proposed cognitive map has high self-consistency.

</details>


### [99] [CAR-SAM: Cross-Attention Reconstruction for Post-Training Quantization of the Segment Anything Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16901)
*Houji Wen,Jiangyong Yu,Jun Li,Dawei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAR-SAM统一量化框架，通过MatMul感知补偿和联合交叉注意力重建机制，解决SAM模型在低比特量化下的注意力消散和重建震荡问题，在4-bit精度下显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM模型计算和内存需求高，难以部署在资源受限设备上。现有PTQ方法未考虑SAM解码器中的交叉注意力架构，导致注意力消散和重建震荡两个核心问题，影响低比特量化性能。

Method: 提出CAR-SAM框架：(1) MatMul感知补偿(MAC)机制，将激活引起的量化误差从矩阵乘法转移到前序线性权重；(2) 联合交叉注意力重建(JCAR)策略，联合重建耦合的注意力分支，抑制震荡并促进稳定收敛。

Result: 在4-bit精度下，CAR-SAM在SAM-B和SAM-L上分别超越现有方法14.6%和6.6% mAP。

Conclusion: CAR-SAM能够稳健地将SAM模型量化至4-bit精度，有效解决了低比特量化中的注意力消散和重建震荡问题，显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Segment Anything Models (SAMs) are extensively used in computer vision for universal image segmentation, but deploying them on resource-constrained devices is challenging due to their high computational and memory demands. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is a widely used technique for model compression and acceleration. However, existing PTQ methods fail to consider the cross-attention architecture in the SAM decoder. This degradation primarily stems from the unique challenges posed by SAMs: (1) Attention dissipation, where the attention information in the decoder, which is crucial for representing segmentation masks, collapses into a diffuse and non-semantic form under low-bit quantization; and (2) Reconstruction oscillation, where bidirectional coupling within the two-way transformer introduces cross-branch error interference and destabilizes convergence. To tackle these issues, we propose CAR-SAM, a unified quantization framework tailored for SAMs. Firstly, to mitigate attention dissipation, we introduce MatMul-Aware Compensation (MAC) mechanism that transfers activation-induced quantization errors from MatMul to preceding linear weights. Secondly, to mitigate oscillation in decoder optimization, we develop a Joint Cross-Attention Reconstruction (JCAR) strategy that jointly reconstructs coupled attention branches, suppressing oscillatory behavior and promoting stable convergence. Extensive experiments show that CAR-SAM robustly quantizes SAM models down to 4-bit precision, surpassing existing methods by 14.6% and 6.6% mAP on SAM-B and SAM-L respectively.

</details>


### [100] [WOW-Seg: A Word-free Open World Segmentation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16903)
*Danyang Li,Tianhao Wu,Bin Li,Zhenyuan Chen,Yang Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Ming-Ming Cheng,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WOW-Seg是一种无需文本提示的开放世界图像分割模型，通过Mask2Token视觉提示模块和Cascade Attention Mask机制，在LVIS数据集上以八分之一参数量超越现有最佳方法，并构建了包含7,662类别的区域识别基准RR-7K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统封闭集分割方法难以适应开放世界场景，而基础分割模型（如SAM）存在强分割能力与弱语义理解之间的显著差距。为弥合这一差距，作者提出WOW-Seg模型。

Method: 提出Mask2Token视觉提示模块，将图像掩码转换为视觉token并与VLLM特征空间对齐；引入Cascade Attention Mask解耦不同实例间的信息，减少实例间干扰；构建了包含7,662类别的开放世界区域识别基准RR-7K。

Result: 在LVIS数据集上，语义相似度达89.7，语义IoU达82.4，以仅八分之一的参数量超越之前最优方法。

Conclusion: WOW-Seg展现了强大的开放世界泛化能力，证明通过视觉提示而非文本提示即可有效实现开放世界分割与识别。

Abstract: Open world image segmentation aims to achieve precise segmentation and semantic understanding of targets within images by addressing the infinitely open set of object categories encountered in the real world. However, traditional closed-set segmentation approaches struggle to adapt to complex open world scenarios, while foundation segmentation models such as SAM exhibit notable discrepancies between their strong segmentation capabilities and relatively weaker semantic understanding. To bridge these discrepancies, we propose WOW-Seg, a Word-free Open World Segmentation model for segmenting and recognizing objects from open-set categories. Specifically, WOW-Seg introduces a novel visual prompt module, Mask2Token, which transforms image masks into visual tokens and ensures their alignment with the VLLM feature space. Moreover, we introduce the Cascade Attention Mask to decouple information across different instances. This approach mitigates inter-instance interference, leading to a significant improvement in model performance. We further construct an open world region recognition test benchmark: the Region Recognition Dataset (RR-7K). With 7,662 classes, it represents the most extensive category-rich region recognition dataset to date. WOW-Seg attains strong results on the LVIS dataset, achieving a semantic similarity of 89.7 and a semantic IoU of 82.4. This performance surpasses the previous SOTA while using only one-eighth the parameter count. These results underscore the strong open world generalization capabilities of WOW-Seg. The code and related resources are available at https://github.com/AAwcAA/WOW-Seg-Meta.

</details>


### [101] [VGGT-Occ: Geometry-Grounded and Density-Aware Gated Fusion for 3D Occupancy Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16911)
*Xun Chen,Tianchen Deng,Rui Wang,Fangjinhua Wang,Junyi Ma,Hongming Shen,Hesheng Wang,Danwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VGGT-Occ 通过在整个流程中嵌入几何令牌，提出投影感知可变形注意力（PA-DA）和视图质量语义门控，实现更准确的3D语义占据预测，在SurroundOcc-nuScenes上达到33.00% IoU和21.08% mIoU，参数仅约41M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D语义占据预测方法中，2D到3D的特征提升受限于初始投影，后续操作（如偏移学习、注意力加权、跨相机聚合）忽略了几何约束，缺乏物理先验。

Method: 提出VGGT-Occ框架：(1) 投影感知可变形注意力（PA-DA），将3D偏移投影回图像平面，利用投影雅可比作为加性偏置抑制不可靠观测；(2) 视图质量语义门控实现跨视图一致性；(3) 粗到细的序列化解码器，通过门控融合从低分辨率逐步精化到高分辨率，按信息密度分配计算。

Result: 在SurroundOcc-nuScenes上，VGGT-Occ达到33.00% IoU和21.08% mIoU（T=1），33.64% IoU和21.43% mIoU（T=2），超越现有方法，占据头仅约41M可训练参数。

Conclusion: 将几何先验嵌入整个3D占据预测流程能有效提升准确性，PA-DA和粗到细解码器在性能和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction requires accurate 2D-to-3D feature lifting, yet current methods restrict camera geometry to initial projections. Subsequent operations like offset learning, attention weighting, and cross-camera aggregation remain geometry-agnostic, ignoring essential physical constraints. We propose VGGT-Occ, a framework that embeds geometric tokens throughout the entire pipeline. We introduce Projection-Aware Deformable Attention (PA-DA) to inject geometry into all attention stages. PA-DA projects 3D offsets back to image planes and leverages the projection Jacobian as an additive bias to suppress unreliable observations. Features are then integrated through a view-quality semantic gate for cross-view consistency. To optimize both efficiency and performance, we employ a sequential coarse-to-fine decoder with gated fusion, where low-resolution features are refined into higher resolutions, allocating computation by information density while substantially reducing decoder cost. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of our approach. On SurroundOcc-nuScenes, VGGT-Occ achieves 33.00\% IoU and 21.08\% mIoU ($T{=}1$), and 33.64\% IoU and 21.43\% mIoU with $T{=}2$ inference, outperforming existing methods, with only ${\sim}41$M trainable parameters in the occupancy head. Code will be released publicly.

</details>


### [102] [HighSync: High-Quality Lip Synchronization via Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16918)
*Saeed Firouzi Daghigh,Majid Iranpour Mobarekeh,Mostafa Alavi,Mehdi Bagheri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HighSync 是一个端到端扩散模型框架，通过解决数据泄露问题，原生支持 512×512 分辨率，在唇同步视频生成中同时实现了高保真画质和精准时序对齐，在电影和广播等专业制作场景中达到 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有唇同步方法难以兼顾图像质量与同步精度，要么视觉质量低，要么嘴唇运动时序不一致；且此前模型中存在数据泄露现象，导致模型未真正依赖音频信号进行时序建模。

Method: 提出 HighSync 端到端扩散框架，核心创新是识别并系统性地消除了数据泄露问题，使模型能够真正学习音频驱动的时间依赖关系，并原生支持 512×512 高分辨率输出。

Result: 在感知质量和同步精度两个维度的全面评估中均达到 SOTA 性能，验证了 HighSync 同时解决画质退化与时序不一致问题的有效性。

Conclusion: HighSync 是首个原生 512×512 分辨率的唇同步模型，通过消除数据泄露实现了高质量的唇同步效果，为影视、广播等专业领域提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: We present HighSync, an end-to-end diffusion-based framework for high-fidelity lip synchronization that generates photorealistic talking-face videos aligned with arbitrary input audio. Existing approaches consistently struggle to reconcile image quality with synchronization accuracy, producing either visually degraded outputs or temporally inconsistent lip movements. HighSync addresses both challenges simultaneously and, to our knowledge, is the first lip sync model to operate natively at 512*512 resolution, positioning it as a viable solution for professional production environments such as the film and broadcast industries. Central to our approach is the identification and systematic elimination of a data leakage phenomenon that has silently undermined temporal modeling in prior work, preventing models from developing a genuine dependence on the audio signal. Comprehensive evaluations across both perceptual quality and synchronization accuracy metrics confirm that HighSync achieves state-of-the-art performance on both fronts. Source code, pre-trained models, and supplementary video results are publicly available at: https://github.com/saeed5959/high_sync

</details>


### [103] [Motion Cues from Image-based Point Tracking for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16922)
*Youngdong Jang,Gyeongrok Oh,Jong Wook Kim,Hyunju Ryu,Hyung-gun Chi,SeungHyeon Kim,Seungryong Kim,Jonghyun Choi,Sangpil Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TrackCue利用点跟踪获取稠密图像轨迹，为LiDAR场景流估计提供更准确的动静分类标签，从而提升自监督场景流学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现存自监督场景流方法依赖稀疏几何观测进行动静分类，易受数据稀疏性和遮挡影响，产生噪声标签导致错误运动引导。

Method: 1) 复用点跟踪获取稠密图像空间轨迹；2) 视觉一致性运动补偿策略分离真实物体运动与自车运动；3) 视觉运动线索提升将补偿后的图像轨迹与LiDAR点关联，细化动静标签。

Result: TrackCue显著提升了动态标签的精度和F1分数，并在自监督场景流估计任务上取得性能提升。

Conclusion: 引入跨模态跟踪线索能够有效弥补稀疏几何观测的不足，为场景流学习提供更可靠的监督信号。

Abstract: LiDAR scene flow estimation is essential for autonomous driving, as it provides 3D motion for each point. Self-supervised approaches use static-dynamic classification to mitigate the imbalance between static and dynamic points, deriving targeted supervision. However, existing methods rely on sparse geometric observations for this classification, making them vulnerable to data sparsity and occlusions. The resulting noisy labels provide incorrect motion guidance and degrade scene flow learning. To address this, we introduce TrackCue, a tracking-guided framework for improving dynamic object representation in LiDAR scene flow estimation. In particular, TrackCue repurposes point tracking to obtain dense image-space trajectories anchored to LiDAR points, providing motion cues beyond sparse geometric observations. Furthermore, we present a visually consistent motion compensation strategy that compares the tracked trajectories with ego-induced rigid trajectories in the image plane, effectively isolating true object motion from ego-induced apparent motion. To transfer these isolated motion cues back to the LiDAR domain, we perform visual motion cue lifting, which associates ego-compensated image trajectories with LiDAR points for static-dynamic label refinement. As a result, TrackCue produces more accurate static-dynamic classification and provides more reliable supervision for scene flow learning. Experimental results show that TrackCue significantly improves the precision and F1 score of dynamic labels, leading to performance gains in self-supervised scene flow estimation.

</details>


### [104] [Neuroscience-inspired Staged Representation Learning with Disentangled Coarse- and Fine-Grained Semantics for EEG Visual Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16923)
*Xiang Gao,Hui Tian,Yanming Zhu,Xuefei Yin,Alan Wee-Chung Liew*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种受神经科学启发的阶段式表示学习框架，将EEG视觉解码分解为低层视觉、高层语义和整合融合三个阶段，并引入多模态双级语义学习机制，在THINGS-EEG基准上取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码方法主要学习单一全局EEG嵌入进行跨模态对齐，忽视了人类视觉处理的分阶段和层次化特性。

Method: 提出阶段式表示学习框架，包含三个阶段：低层视觉表示学习、高层语义表示学习、整合信息融合；引入多模态双级语义学习机制，分离粗粒度标签语义与细粒度图像级视觉语义信息；引入语义潜通道作为计算表示通道。

Result: 在THINGS-EEG基准上，主体依赖零样本评估中取得优越性能，主体独立零样本评估中实现改进的精确检索。层式检索、时间累积、扩展多图像检索和消融实验均验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 显式建模阶段式感知、语义和整合表示为EEG视觉解码提供了有效的神经科学启发框架。

Abstract: Decoding visual information from electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains a fundamental challenge in brain-computer interfaces and medical rehabilitation. Existing EEG visual decoding methods mainly focus on learning a single global EEG embedding for cross-modal alignment, but they largely overlook the staged and hierarchical characteristics of human visual processing. To address this limitation, we propose a neuroscience-inspired staged representation learning framework that reformulates EEG visual decoding as a stage-specific representation decomposition problem. The proposed framework organizes EEG representation learning into three complementary phases: low-level visual representation learning, high-level semantic representation learning, and integrative information fusion. To strengthen semantic modeling, we further introduce a multimodal dual-level semantic learning mechanism that separates coarse label-level semantics from fine image-level visual-semantic information. In addition, semantic latent channels are introduced as computational representation channels generated from observed visual EEG signals, expanding the channel-level semantic representation space for structured semantic abstraction and cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments on the THINGS-EEG benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance under subject-dependent zero-shot evaluation and improved exact retrieval under subject-independent zero-shot evaluation. Additional analyses, including layer-wise retrieval, temporal accumulation, expanded multi-image retrieval, and ablation studies, further support the effectiveness of staged decomposition and structured semantic modeling. These results suggest that explicitly modeling staged perceptual, semantic, and integrative representations provides an effective neuroscience-inspired framework for EEG-based visual decoding.

</details>


### [105] [P2GS: Physical Prior-guided Gaussian Splatting for Photometrically Consistent Urban Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16925)
*Kota Shimomura,Hidehisa Arai,Tsubasa Takahashi,Takayoshi Yamashita,Hironobu Fujiyoshi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: P2GS提出了一种物理一致的3D高斯泼溅框架，能够从多视角LDR图像中联合分解出视图无关的线性HDR辐射场、每视角曝光强度和色调映射函数，无需HDR监督即可解决自动驾驶场景中因曝光不一致导致的伪影和光照不一致问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统3DGS假设视图间曝光和色调映射一致，但真实驾驶数据因不同相机管线、动态户外光照等因素违反该假设，导致辐射场中嵌入曝光差异和传感器噪声，产生伪影和不一致光照，影响闭环仿真和感知模型的真实性。

Method: P2GS基于物理成像过程构建统一优化策略，联合分解视图不变的线性HDR辐射场、每视角曝光参数和色调映射函数，仅使用LDR图像输入，施加相对曝光一致性和HDR域辐射正则化约束。

Result: 在真实和仿真驾驶场景中，P2GS在LDR重建上达到或超越先前方法水平，同时显著提升光度一致性，实现可靠的曝光归一化和物理合理的光照分布。

Conclusion: P2GS有效解决了自动驾驶场景中多视图曝光不一致问题，在保持3DGS实时渲染效率的同时，获得了物理一致的高质量辐射场，为自动驾驶闭环仿真提供了更可靠的场景表示基础。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently emerged as a powerful explicit representation enabling fast, high-fidelity rendering, making it a promising foundation for closed-loop simulators and perception models in autonomous driving. However, conventional 3DGS implicitly assumes consistent exposure and tone mapping across views. Real driving data violates this assumption due to heterogeneous camera pipelines and dynamic outdoor illumination, baking exposure discrepancies and sensor noise into the radiance field and producing artifacts and inconsistent illumination especially in static backgrounds crucial for realistic simulation. These issues are amplified in autonomous driving, where sparse viewpoints, varying exposures, and outdoor lighting interact, while prior work mainly targets dynamic-object reconstruction and overlooks cross-view photometric consistency. To address this limitation, we introduce P2GS, a physically consistent Gaussian Splatting framework that jointly decomposes a view-invariant linear HDR radiance field, per-view exposure scales, and tone-mapping functions from only LDR images without HDR supervision. P2GS employs a unified optimization strategy grounded in the physical image-formation process, enforcing relative-exposure consistency and HDR-domain radiance regularization. This yields a radiance field robust to inter-camera illumination differences while preserving the real-time efficiency of standard 3DGS. Experiments across real and simulated driving environments show that P2GS matches or surpasses prior methods in LDR reconstruction while providing substantially improved photometric consistency, reliable exposure normalization, and physically coherent illumination across diverse scenes.

</details>


### [106] [DEVIS-GRPO: Unleashing GRPO on Dynamic Extreme View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16937)
*Yi Zuo,Huimin Wu,Lingling Li,Fang Liu,Licheng Jiao,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DEVIS-GRPO，一种基于GRPO的在线策略梯度方法，通过累积小视角增量实现大视角运动下的轨迹可控视频生成，无需大量标注数据，在多个数据集上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹可控视频生成方法在小视角相机运动下表现良好，但在大视角运动下性能显著下降；而现有的极端视角合成方法需要专门的视频配对数据，标注成本高昂。

Method: 提出DEVIS-GRPO框架，核心是ADEVIS采样策略，通过逐步累积小视角增量实现大视角相机运动；同时设计多层级一致性-质量奖励函数来筛选高质量样本进行模型优化。

Result: 在Kubric-4D数据集上，PSNR提升21.57%，SSIM提升7.31%；在iPhone数据集上，LPIPS降低18.56%。

Conclusion: DEVIS-GRPO有效解决了大视角运动下轨迹可控视频生成的难题，通过渐进式累积策略避免了昂贵的数据标注，并且采样多样性更高，实验结果证明了方法的优越性。

Abstract: Trajectory-controlled video generation has become essential for controllable video generation. While current methods perform well under small-view camera motions, they degrade significantly with large-view motions. Existing solutions for extreme-view synthesis typically require dedicated video pairs, demanding substantial annotation effort. To address these limitations, we propose Dynamic Extreme VIew Synthesis-GRPO (DEVIS-GRPO), a GRPO-based framework for trajectory-controlled video generation, the first online policy gradient method for extreme view video generation. Central to our approach is a novel sampling strategy: Accumulative Dynamic Extreme VIew Synthesis (ADEVIS), which achieves large-view camera motions by progressively accumulating small-view increments. This method delivers two key advantages: 1) enhanced training efficiency, as it eliminates the need to warm-start the policy model by collecting expensive paired large-view videos, and 2) increased sampling diversity, achieved by flexibly varying trajectory configurations. Finally, we designed a multi-level consistency-quality reward function to select high-quality samples for model optimization. Experiments on the Kubric-4D, iPhone, and DL3DV datasets demonstrate our method's superiority. On Kubric-4D, we achieve relative improvements of 21.57% in PSNR and 7.31% in SSIM over the second-best method in non-occlusion areas. On iPhone, LPIPS is reduced by 18.56%.

</details>


### [107] [Beyond Point-Wise Matching: Structural Representation Alignment for Accelerating Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16949)
*Shaodong Xu,Zhendong Wang,Litong Gong,Zexian Li,Wengang Zhou,Tiezheng Ge,Houqiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出sREPA框架，通过在扩散Transformer中对特征图施加结构关系一致性约束（而非逐点匹配），显著加速训练、提升生成质量，优于现有对齐方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示对齐方法（如REPA、iREPA）主要采用逐点匹配目标或隐式架构改进，未能显式建模预训练视觉表示中蕴含的空间关系几何结构，导致对丰富空间拓扑信息的捕获不足。

Method: 提出sREPA（结构表示对齐框架），将对齐目标从逐特征点匹配重构为特征图之间关系几何的一致性约束，强制模型内化预训练特征中的整体空间布局和结构相关性。

Result: 相比现有最先进的对齐策略，sREPA实现了更快、更稳定的收敛，同时提升了生成样本质量。

Conclusion: 扩散Transformer中的有效对齐应被形式化为显式的结构约束，而非逐元素监督，这能更好地捕获视觉表征中的空间拓扑信息。

Abstract: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) demonstrate that aligning noisy latent states with well-trained semantic features-as pioneered by Representation Alignment (REPA)-can substantially accelerate training and improve generation fidelity. Subsequent analysis(e.g., iREPA) suggests that these gains arise primarily from transferring spatial structure contained in pre-trained vision representations. However, mostly existing alignment methods employ point-wise matching objectives or rely on implicit architectural tweaks, which fail to explicitly model the spatial relational geometry inherent in vision foundation models. We argue that such element-wise supervision is insufficient to capture the rich spatial topology of visual representations, and that effective alignment for generation should instead be formulated as an explicit structural constraint. To this end, we propose sREPA, a structural REPresentation Alignment framework to enforce consistency in the relational geometry of feature maps, rather than merely matching individual feature points. By encouraging the model to internalize holistic spatial layouts and structural correlations from pre-trained features, sREPA achieves faster and more stable convergence, along with improved sample quality, compared to state-of-the-art alignment strategies. Our code and models will be released.

</details>


### [108] [Edit-GRPO: A Locality-Preserving Policy Optimization Framework for Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16951)
*Shaodong Xu,Zexian Li,Zhendong Wang,Litong Gong,Tiezheng Ge,Wengang Zhou,Bo Zheng,Houqiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Edit-GRPO 提出了一种保持局部性的策略优化框架，通过解耦编辑区域与保留区域的优化目标，在图像编辑中实现局部改进的同时保持全局视觉一致性，有效抑制了上下文失真和边界不一致等伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化式图像编辑方法将图像视为整体进行全局策略更新，导致编辑意图（局部）与优化信号（全局）不匹配，产生非预期的上下文变化，破坏了空间局部性。

Method: 提出 Edit-GRPO 框架，显式解耦编辑目标与保留目标，为编辑区域和非编辑区域分配区域特定的优化信号，使策略更新与编辑任务的空域结构对齐。

Result: 在多种图像编辑场景下，Edit-GRPO 相比现有优化方法显著提升了局部性保持能力，同时保持了强编辑性能，有效抑制了上下文失真和边界不一致等常见伪影。

Conclusion: Edit-GRPO 通过区域解耦的优化策略有效解决了图像编辑中局部性与全局一致性的矛盾，验证了该框架的通用性和有效性。

Abstract: A fundamental challenge in image editing lies in preserving spatial locality: edits should improve targeted content without inadvertently altering surrounding regions. However, most optimization-based editing approaches treat images as holistic entities, causing global policy updates that undermine locality and introduce undesired context changes. We observe that this issue stems from a mismatch between localized editing intent and globally applied optimization signals. Motivated by this insight, we propose Edit-GRPO, preserving Locality while optimizing image editing, a locality-preserving policy optimization framework that explicitly decouples editing and preservation objectives. By assigning region-specific optimization signals to edit and non-edit areas, Edit-GRPO aligns policy updates with the spatial structure of editing tasks, enabling localized improvements while maintaining global visual coherence. This design effectively suppresses common artifacts such as context distortion and boundary inconsistency. Extensive experiments across diverse image editing scenarios demonstrate that Edit-GRPO significantly improves locality preservation while maintaining strong editing performance compared to existing optimization-based methods, validating the generality and effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [109] [Latent Action Control for Reasoning-Guided Unified Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16961)
*Fuxiang Zhai,Sixiang Chen,Yingjin Li,Shuaibo Li,Jianyu Lai,Tengjun Huang,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出潜在动作控制（LAC）方法，通过在统一生成器内部引入隐式连续动作轨迹，使视觉理解能够直接调控图像生成过程，从而弥合理解与生成控制之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型虽能同时编码视觉理解与图像生成，但理解能力并不能自动转化为对生成过程的控制——模型可以推断物体、关系或知识线索，却无法在生成图像中有效实例化这些信息。

Method: LAC将推理表示为生成器内部的隐式连续动作轨迹（包含规划、内部草稿、诊断与细化），通过先验引导的变分潜在动作对齐（利用训练时渲染的语义先验）和潜在流GRPO（对齐潜在到图像的展开与终端视觉反馈）来学习未观测的动作轨迹，并将其注入基于流的生成条件中。

Result: 在BAGEL-7B-MoT上实例化后，LAC在GenEval、WISE和T2I-CompBench上持续提升了组合性和知识引导的图像生成性能，在空间关系、属性绑定和世界知识敏感提示上提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 统一生成模型不仅需要编码理解，更需要在生成过程中使理解具有可操作性（actionable），LAC通过隐式动作控制提供了从推理到生成的有效控制路径。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models can encode visual understanding and image generation within a shared backbone, yet understanding does not automatically translate into control: models may infer objects, relations, or knowledge cues but fail to instantiate them in the generated image. We propose Latent Action Control (LAC), which makes reasoning actionable by representing it as hidden continuous actions inside a unified generator. Given a prompt, LAC rolls out a role-structured latent trajectory for planning, internal visual drafting, diagnosis, and refinement, and injects these actions into the hidden stream that conditions flow-based generation, without producing reasoning tokens or intermediate images. Since such action trajectories are unobserved, LAC learns them through prior-guided variational latent action alignment from training-only rendered semantic priors, draft image features, and supervised halting signals, followed by Latent-Flow GRPO to align the latent-to-image rollout with terminal visual feedback. This provides a control path from inferred relations, bindings, and knowledge cues to the generation process. Instantiated on BAGEL-7B-MoT, LAC consistently improves compositional and knowledge-grounded generation across GenEval, WISE, and T2I-CompBench, with the largest gains on spatial relations, attribute binding, and world-knowledge-sensitive prompts. Ablations and latent interventions show that the learned action trajectory is consumed by the generator, suggesting that unified generation benefits when understanding is not only encoded, but made actionable during generation.

</details>


### [110] [OmniVL-Guard Pro: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Omnibus Vision-Language Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16962)
*Jinjie Shen,Zheng Huang,Yuchen Zhang,Yujiao Wu,Yaxiong Wang,Lechao Cheng,Shengeng Tang,Tianrui Hui,Nan Pu,Zhun Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniVL-Guard Pro，一种工具增强型智能体，通过引入外部工具（实时搜索、局部裁剪缩放、边缘异常筛查、人脸检测、视频帧提取、SAM3分割）和两阶段训练策略（树结构自演化轨迹生成+检查器引导的强化学习），突破闭集视觉语言伪造检测的局限性，实现开放世界线索驱动的统一取证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言伪造检测方法局限于闭集范式，依赖模型自身能力，但多模态大模型受限于有限参数、静态训练语料和有限感知分辨率，在动态开放世界取证中存在性能天花板，尤其在需要外部线索的实时事件验证和需要细粒度局部操作的伪造分割任务上表现不佳。

Method: 1) 工具增强框架：集成实时事件搜索、局部裁剪缩放、边缘异常筛查、人脸检测、视频帧提取、SAM3分割等外部工具；2) Tree-Structured Self-Evolving Tool Trajectory Generation：通过种子引导、无引导者自演化和弱提示难样本合成生成多样化工具推理轨迹，构建Full-Spectrum Tool Reasoning (FSTR)数据集；3) Checker-Guided Agentic Reinforcement Learning (CGARL)：提供过程级监督，惩罚答案正确但推理路径扭曲的情况。

Result: 在多个任务上达到最先进性能，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 从"扩大模型规模"转向"借助外部工具"，为开放世界伪造取证提供了新的范式，工具增强+过程级强化学习是突破闭集局限的有效路径。

Abstract: Existing vision-language forgery detection and grounding methods operate under a closed-world paradigm, assuming verification can be completed by the model alone. However, self-contained MLLMs are constrained by finite parametric knowledge, static training corpora, and limited perceptual resolution, creating a practical ceiling in dynamic open-world forensics -- particularly for real-time event verification requiring external clues and forgery segmentation demanding fine-grained scrutiny of local manipulations. To address these limitations, we shift from scaling up the self-contained model toward reaching beyond it. We propose \textbf{OmniVL-Guard Pro}, a tool-augmented agent that extends unified forensics from closed-world prediction to open-world clues-driven reasoning. OmniVL-Guard Pro integrates a tool environment spanning real-time event search, local cropping and zooming, edge-anomaly screening, face detection, video frame extraction, and SAM3-based segmentation. To generate high-quality tool-reasoning trajectories, we introduce \textbf{Tree-Structured Self-Evolving Tool Trajectory Generation}, which produces diverse trajectories through seed guidance, guider-free self-evolution, and weakly-hinted hard sample synthesis, yielding the Full-Spectrum Tool Reasoning (FSTR) dataset for training. We further propose \textbf{Checker-Guided Agentic Reinforcement Learning} (CGARL), which provides process-level supervision to penalize cases where the answer is correct but the reasoning is distorted. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniVL-Guard Pro achieves state-of-the-art performance across various tasks, and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization. The FSTR dataset and code for OmniVL-Guard Pro will be publicly released at \url{https://github.com/shen8424/OmniVL-Guard-Pro}.

</details>


### [111] [Expandable, Compressible, Mineable: Open-World Thermal Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16967)
*Pu Li,Huafeng Li,Yafei Zhang,Wen Wang,Neng Dong,Jie Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ECMRNet是一种面向开放世界热红外图像恢复的可扩展、可压缩、可挖掘的持续学习网络，通过"扩展-压缩-挖掘"闭环流程应对新退化类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全合一图像恢复方法基于封闭集假设，无法持续适应开放世界中断涌现和演化的热红外图像退化类型。

Method: 1）将中间表示分解为组隔离子空间，冻结历史组并同构扩展新组实现参数隔离与快速适应；2）提出结构熵剪枝，通过二维结构熵最小化识别并移除冗余通道组，实现自适应压缩；3）设计子退化知识挖掘模块，动态检索并重组历史表示中的可迁移成分以处理复合退化。

Result: 在多种单一和复合退化场景下，ECMRNet以更少的参数和计算成本实现了更优的整体性能。

Conclusion: ECMRNet通过持续学习范式有效解决了开放世界热红外图像恢复中的新退化适应问题，实现了可控的模型演化。

Abstract: In open-world settings, thermal infrared (TIR) image degradations continuously emerge and evolve, while most existing all-in-one restoration methods are built on a closed-set assumption and struggle to continually adapt to novel degradations. To address this, we propose ECMRNet, an Expandable, Compressible, and Mineable Restoration Network for open-world TIR restoration from a continual learning perspective. Conceptually, ECMRNet unifies continual degradation learning as an "expand-compress-mine" closed-loop process, enabling sustained adaptation to new degradations with controllable evolution. Structurally, ECMRNet decomposes intermediate representations into group-isolated subspaces, and achieves strict parameter isolation and fast adaptation to new degradations by freezing historical groups and isomorphically expanding new ones. To curb model growth as tasks accumulate, we present Structural Entropy Pruning, which identifies and removes redundant channel groups via two-dimensional structural entropy minimization, achieving information contribution-driven adaptive compression. Moreover, we design a Sub-degradation Knowledge Mining Module that dynamically retrieves and recombines transferable components from historical representations to improve restoration under compound degradations. Experimental results demonstrate that ECMRNet achieves superior overall performance across diverse single and compound degradations while using fewer parameters and lower computational cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kust-lp/ECMRNet.

</details>


### [112] [SHED: Style-Homogenized Embedding Alignment for Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16973)
*Kai Gan,Tong Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SHED方法，通过对齐风格同质化的嵌入而非原始表示来解决CLIP在领域泛化中的信息不对称问题，在五个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP直接对齐图像-文本嵌入存在信息不对称：图像编码既包含类别语义又包含领域风格，而文本提示主要传达基本类别信息，这阻碍了模型向未见领域的泛化。

Method: 1) 训练时：从图像嵌入中移除各源域的特定风格质心，从文本嵌入中移除全局质心（文本嵌入通过对多样化提示模板取平均得到）；2) 推理时：将多样化的文本领域质心投影到视觉空间，通过隶属度加权聚合预测。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上达到SOTA，如DomainNet上相比标准微调提升4.0%。

Conclusion: 通过对齐风格同质化嵌入而非原始表示，有效缓解了CLIP中的信息不对称问题，显著提升了领域泛化性能。

Abstract: Domain generalization aims to enhance model robustness against unseen domains with embedding distribution shifts. While large-scale vision-language models like CLIP exhibit strong generalization, their direct image-text embedding alignment suffers from inherent information asymmetry: images encode both class semantics and domain-specific styles, whereas text prompts primarily convey basic class cues. This asymmetry hinders generalization to novel domains in realistic scenarios. To address this, we propose Style-Homogenized Embedding alignment for Domain-generalization (SHED), a novel CLIP-based method that aligns style-homogenized embeddings instead of raw representations from encoders in CLIP. During training, SHED removes domain-specific style centroids from both image embeddings computed per source domains and text embeddings which are averaged across diverse prompt templates and stripped of a global centroid. For inference, considering the lack of target domain information, SHED projects diverse textual domain centroids into the visual space and aggregates predictions via membership weighting. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show SHED achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming prior methods significantly (e.g., +4.0\% on DomainNet vs. standard fine-tuning).

</details>


### [113] [Statistical Hand Shape Modeling from Clinical CT Scans Using Deep Learning and Implicit Skinning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16980)
*Gokce Guven,Hasan Fehmi Ates,Deniz Karasahin,Kaan Erdogan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种AI辅助的手部解剖重建管线，利用Pix2Pix cGAN去除石膏和背景伪影，结合3D Slicer分割和GBCPD++非刚性配准，从1271例肘到手CT扫描中建立统计形状模型，在90例样本上实现了与ANSUR II一致的手部形状变化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部解剖的精确分割和统计形状建模对医学诊断、人体工学和生物力学具有重要意义，但现有方法在处理CT中的石膏伪影和背景噪声时效果有限，缺乏端到端的自动化重建流程。

Method: 1) Pix2Pix cGAN去除CT中的石膏和背景伪影；2) 3D Slicer提取皮肤和骨骼掩膜并转换为闭合曲面网格；3) 骨骼网格构建骨架表示，实现隐式蒙皮对齐；4) GBCPD++算法对手部皮肤表面进行非刚性配准建立点对应关系；5) PCA对配准模型进行统计形状分析。

Result: Pix2Pix预处理在测试集上Dice系数达0.9856，IoU达0.9720；对90例手指完全可见且解剖分离的扫描进行统计建模，形状分布与ANSUR II高度一致。

Conclusion: 该AI辅助重建管线在生物力学建模、人体工效学优化、假体设计和精准医学诊断方面具有显著的应用潜力。

Abstract: Accurate segmentation and statistical shape modeling of hand anatomy have significant implications for medical diagnostics, ergonomics, and biomechanics. This study proposes an AI-assisted reconstruction pipeline for segmenting and analyzing hand anatomy from 1,271 elbow-to-hand (e2h-CT) computed tomography scans. A Pix2Pix-based conditional generative adversarial network is first employed to remove plaster cast and background artifacts from CT volumes. The cleaned scans are then processed in 3D Slicer to extract skin and bone masks, which are converted into closed-surface mesh models. Segmented bone meshes are used to construct skeletal representations, enabling implicit skinning to align all hand models into a standardized anatomical configuration. Subsequently, non-rigid registration is performed on the hand skin surfaces using the Geodesic Based Coherent Point Drift++ (GBCPD++) algorithm to establish point-wise correspondence across subjects. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is then applied to the registered models to quantify anatomical shape variability. The Pix2Pix preprocessing stage achieved a Dice coefficient of 0.9856 and an IoU of 0.9720 on the held-out test set. Statistical modeling was performed on a subset of 90 scans in which the fingers were fully visible and anatomically separated. The resulting statistical shape distributions demonstrate strong agreement with the U.S. Army Anthropometric Survey (ANSUR II), supporting the anatomical validity of the reconstructed models. The proposed methodology demonstrates significant potential for advancing biomechanical modeling, ergonomic optimization, prosthetic design, and precision medical diagnostics.

</details>


### [114] [Rethinking the State Update Gate for Long-Sequence Recurrent 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16981)
*Kejun Ren,Lei Jin,Tianxin Huang,Lianming Xu,Li Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现TTT3R风格的逐token门控机制存在结构瓶颈（门控值中位数0.31，不超过0.6，近乎帧不变），导致有效记忆窗口仅约3帧。作者提出一种标量帧级门控α_t，通过帧间内部特征变化闭式求解，无需参数/训练/额外前向传播，在6个基准上将ATE降低51%，AbsRel降低12.8%，在KITTI长序列上超越LongStream和Keyframe-VO，保持严格恒定内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式3D重建方法在恒定内存预算下，逐token门控存在结构瓶颈，门控值幅度受限且帧间变化极小，导致长序列漂移。现有推理时方法仅在逐token帧内层面调节更新，缺少帧级贡献控制维度。

Method: 提出标量帧级门控α_t∈(0,1]，通过帧间内部特征变化以闭式解导出，是经典SLAM关键帧选择的连续松弛版本，无需额外参数、训练或前向传播。

Result: 在6个基准上：长TUM-RGBD序列ATE降低51%，Bonn视频深度AbsRel降低12.8%，KITTI长序列姿态估计超越LongStream和Keyframe-VO，保持严格恒定内存且零训练成本。

Conclusion: 帧级门控α_t有效解决了逐token门控的结构瓶颈，显著提升了流式3D重建在长序列下的性能，且不增加计算和内存开销。该发现揭示了现有方法在帧级更新维度上的缺失，为流式重建提供了简单有效的改进方案。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction under a strict constant-memory budget hinges on how the recurrent state is updated as the stream evolves. We profile TTT3R-style per-token gates across five benchmarks and discover a structural bottleneck: the gate is intrinsically bounded in magnitude (median $0.31$; never exceeding $0.6$) and nearly frame-invariant, yielding an effective memory horizon of only $\sim$3 frames per state token, which serves as the structural origin of long-sequence drift. We trace this to a missing axis: existing inference-time methods modulate updates only at the per-token, intra-frame level, while the orthogonal frame-level question of \emph{how strongly each frame should contribute to the state} has been treated as content-independent. We close this gap with a scalar frame-level gate $α_t \in (0, 1]$ derived in closed form from frame-to-frame changes of internal features -- a continuous relaxation of classical Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) keyframe selection that requires no parameters, no training, and no extra forward pass. Across six benchmarks spanning camera pose, video depth, and 3D reconstruction at sequence lengths up to $4,541$ frames, our gate cuts ATE by $51\%$ on long TUM-RGBD pose sequences, reduces AbsRel by $12.8\%$ on Bonn video depth, and on KITTI long-sequence pose estimation surpasses both LongStream and Keyframe-VO, while retaining strictly constant memory at zero training cost.

</details>


### [115] [DreamEdit3D: Personalization of Multi-View Diffusion Models for 3D Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16990)
*Jinxin Ai,Matthias Nießner,Ziya Erkoç*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种将2D扩散模型的个性化能力扩展到3D编辑的方法，通过正交视图渲染、语义分割、解耦token学习和两阶段优化，实现基于文本的3D组合式物体级编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D扩散模型在身份保持个性化方面取得了显著成功，但将其扩展到3D资产仍面临多视图一致性和空间控制的复杂性挑战，现有方法在这两方面表现不足。

Method: 1) 正交视图渲染 + 物体级分割掩码提取；2) 两阶段优化策略：阶段一为多视图文本反转+注意力对齐，阶段二为多视图扩散模型全微调；3) 推理时解耦token与编辑提示组合生成多视图一致图像，再提升为3D网格。

Result: 在多种编辑场景下的广泛评估表明，该方法成功将2D个性化的灵活性迁移到3D，在编辑保真度和身份保持方面均达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过解耦token学习和两阶段优化，有效解决了3D编辑中的多视图一致性和空间控制问题，实现了文本驱动的组合式3D物体级编辑。

Abstract: While 2D diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in identity-preserving personalization, extending this capability to 3D assets remains a significant challenge due to the complexities of multi-view consistency and spatial control. Inspired by these 2D advancements, we present a novel personalization method for text-guided 3D editing that enables compositional, object-level control through natural language. Given a 3D input, we render orthogonal views and extract object-level segmentation masks to isolate semantic components. We then learn distinct token embeddings for each component through a tailored two-phase optimization strategy: multi-view textual inversion with attention alignment, followed by full fine-tuning of multi-view diffusion model. During inference, these disentangled tokens seamlessly compose with editing prompts to generate multi-view consistent images, which are subsequently lifted into high-fidelity textured 3D meshes. Extensive evaluations across diverse editing scenarios demonstrate that our method successfully transfers the flexibility of 2D personalization to 3D, achieving state-of-the-art edit faithfulness and identity preservation compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [116] [RHINO: Reconstructing Human Interactions with Novel Objects from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17014)
*Lixin Xue,Chengwei Zheng,Georgios Paschalidis,Chen Guo,Manuel Kaufmann,Juan Zarate,Dimitrios Tzionas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RHINO是一个三步框架，能从单目RGB视频中联合重建3D人体、新物体和静态场景，利用3D基础模型和组合神经场实现，在4D重建和新视角合成上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D重建工作要么单独处理人体或物体，忽略两者交互；要么假设已知3D形状或相机参数，无法适应真实应用场景。本文旨在从单目RGB视频中同时恢复人体、被操纵的新物体和静态场景的3D信息。

Method: 三步框架：1) 利用3D感知基础模型获得线索，稳定SfM，分别从前景和背景像素重建物体粗形状/表观运动与场景粗形状/相机运动；2) 用现成方法估计人体，减去相机运动提取物体运动，将三者对齐到同一世界坐标系；3) 用组合神经场（每个组件带符号距离场）细化形状，加入可微接触先验（吸引表面+惩罚穿透）提升物理合理性。

Result: 在新采集的与体积4D捕捉舞台同步的单目视频数据集上，RHINO在新视角合成和4D重建任务中均优于现有最先进方法。消融实验验证了每个阶段的贡献。

Conclusion: 提出了一种无需已知3D形状或相机参数的端到端框架，能够从单目视频中联合重建人体、物体和场景，为物理合理的3D交互理解提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing people, objects, and their interactions in 3D is a long-standing goal for intelligent systems. Often the input is RGB video from a moving camera, making the task ill-posed; depth is ambiguous, humans and objects occlude each other, and camera and object motion entangle to create apparent motion. Most prior work addresses humans or objects in isolation, ignoring their interplay, or assumes known 3D shapes or cameras, which is impractical for real-world applications. We develop RHINO (Reconstructing Human Interactions with Novel Objects), a three-step framework that recovers in 3D a human, novel (unseen) manipulated object, and static scene in a common world frame from a monocular RGB video. First, we leverage 3D-aware foundation models to obtain cues that stabilize Structure-from-Motion (SfM) even for low-texture regions; this yields a coarse shape and apparent motion of a manipulated object from foreground pixels, and a coarse scene shape and camera motion from background pixels. Second, we estimate a human in the camera frame via an off-the-shelf method, and subtract the camera motion from apparent motion to extract the object motion; this registers the human, object, and coarse scene shapes into a common world frame. Third, we refine shapes using a compositional neural field with per-component signed-distance fields. The latter further enables differentiable contact priors that attract surfaces while penalizing interpenetration, improving the physical plausibility of the final reconstruction. For evaluation, we capture a new dataset of handheld monocular videos synchronized with a volumetric 4D capture stage, providing ground-truth shape and camera motion. RHINO outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on novel-view synthesis and 4D reconstruction. Ablations show that each stage contributes substantially. Code and data are available at https://lxxue.github.io/RHINO.

</details>


### [117] [StreamingEffect: Real-Time Human-Centric Video Effect Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17019)
*Yiren Song,Cheng Liu,Yuxin Jiang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StreamingEffect，一种面向人像的实时流式视频特效框架。通过将双向教师模型蒸馏为因果自回归学生模型（50步→4步采样），并结合关键帧控制和视频特效数据集VideoEffect-130K，实现了在单卡H200上实时生成720p高质量视频编辑效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频特效生成在直播、娱乐等以人为中心的应用中需求迫切，但面临数据缺乏和缺乏可部署的编辑模型两大瓶颈。现有加速工作主要聚焦文生视频，对视频编辑的高效蒸馏探索不足。

Method: 1) 采用上下文视频编辑架构，训练高质量双向教师模型；2) 将其蒸馏为因果自回归学生模型，并将采样步数从50步压缩至4步；3) 引入关键帧控制机制，支持在线注入参考特效帧并通过流式传播实现交互式编辑；4) 构建VideoEffect-130K数据集，包含70K特效视频和60K编辑视频，覆盖600种特效类别。

Result: 在单卡H200 GPU上实现实时、高质量的720p视频编辑，显著优于现有方法的速度和质量。

Conclusion: StreamingEffect通过知识蒸馏与关键帧控制，有效解决了流式人像视频特效生成的实时性与质量权衡问题，填补了高效视频编辑蒸馏领域的空白，并提供了大规模数据集以推动该方向研究。

Abstract: Streaming video effect generation is highly desirable for live human-centric applications such as e-commerce streaming, entertainment, and vlogging, yet remains difficult due to the lack of suitable data and deployable editing models. Unlike generic video generation, this task requires real-time video-to-video editing that adds expressive effects while preserving human identity, background content, and temporal consistency. Existing acceleration efforts mainly focus on text-to-video generation, while efficient distillation for video editing remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we present \textbf{StreamingEffect}, a real-time human-centric streaming video effect framework. We adopt an in-context video editing architecture and train a high-quality bidirectional teacher, then distill it into a causal autoregressive student and further reduce sampling from 50 steps to 4 steps. We also introduce keyframe control, allowing reference effect frames to be injected online and propagated through the stream for interactive editing. To address the data bottleneck, we construct \textbf{VideoEffect-130K}, to our knowledge the largest human-centric video effect dataset, containing 70K effect videos and 60K editing videos across 600 effect categories curated from short-video and editing platforms. Experiments show that our method enables real-time, high-quality 720p video editing on a single H200 GPU.

</details>


### [118] [Thermal-Only Crowd Counting with Deployment-Time Privacy Protection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17042)
*Yifei Qian,Zhongliang Guo,Chun Tong Lei,Bowen Deng,Chun Pong Lau,Xiaopeng Hong,Michael P. Pound*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个仅依赖热成像的隐私保护人群计数框架，利用深度到RGB的扩散模型作为跨模态桥梁增强热成像特征，实验表明单步LCM去噪效果最优，实现了与RGB-T融合方法相当的性能，同时消除了推理时对RGB数据的依赖，大幅降低隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-T热成像人群计数方法存在两大问题：RGB数据在公共监控中引发隐私担忧，以及多模态配准不佳导致融合性能下降。作者希望设计一种仅依赖热成像的框架，从根本上消除RGB带来的隐私风险。

Method: 提出纯热成像框架，使用深度到RGB扩散模型作为跨模态桥梁，从深度信息中提取判别性特征以增强热成像表征。特别发现单步LCM去噪能最忠实保留深度条件信号的结构内容，多步去噪反而导致特征解耦并累积误差。

Result: 在RGBT-CC和DroneRGBT数据集上，该方法在仅需热成像输入的情况下，达到了与最先进的RGB-T融合方法相竞争的性能水平。

Conclusion: 提出的纯热成像框架有效解决了RGB隐私问题，同时保持了计数精度。单步LCM去噪策略被证明是最优的跨模态特征提取方式，为隐私敏感场景下的智能监控提供了可行方案。

Abstract: While RGB-Thermal crowd counting has shown promise, the paradigm faces critical limitations: RGB data raises privacy concerns in public surveillance, and multi-modal misalignment degrades fusion performance. We propose the first thermal-only framework specifically designed for privacy-conscious crowd counting, eliminating RGB dependency at inference time and substantially reducing the privacy exposure associated with continuous RGB capture in public surveillance deployments. To mitigate thermal ambiguity, we leverage depth-to-RGB diffusion models as a cross-modal bridge, extracting discriminative features that enhance thermal representations. Critically, we demonstrate that single-step LCM denoising yields features most faithful to the structural content of the depth conditioning signal, while multi-step approaches progressively decouple features from the conditioning input and accumulate errors that degrade counting accuracy. Experiments on RGBT-CC and DroneRGBT datasets show our method achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art RGB-T fusion methods, while requiring only thermal input during inference, eliminating the need for continuous RGB capture that constitutes the primary privacy concern in real-world surveillance deployment. The code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [119] [EPIC-Bench: A Perception-Centric Benchmark for Fine-Grained Embodied Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17070)
*Haozhe Shan,Xiancong Ren,Han Dong,Haoyuan Shi,Yingji Zhang,Jiayu Hu,Yi Zhang,Yong Dai,Bin Shen,Lizhen Qu,Zenglin Xu,Xiaozhu Ju*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EPIC-Bench，一个用于评估大视觉语言模型在具身智能中视觉感知能力的细粒度基准测试，包含6.6k标注三元组和89个模型评估，揭示当前模型在视觉-文本对齐方面的瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多采用问答或多选格式，允许模型利用语言先验而非真正的视觉理解，缺乏对具身智能体中视觉感知能力的系统评估。

Method: 构建EPIC-Bench基准，包含6.6k个(图像, 文本, 掩码)三元组，覆盖23个细粒度任务，分为目标定位、导航、操作三个核心阶段。对89个前沿VLM进行全面评估。

Result: 先进推理模型表现有潜力，但当前VLM在物理交互的复杂视觉-文本对齐上普遍困难，特别是在多目标计数、部分-整体关系理解、可操作区域检测等任务上存在明显瓶颈。

Conclusion: EPIC-Bench为推进下一代视觉驱动具身模型提供了坚实基础和可操作的见解。

Abstract: While large vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as the perceptual backbone for embodied agents, existing benchmarks often rely on question-answering or multiple-choice formats. These protocols allow models to exploit linguistic priors rather than demonstrating genuine visual grounding. To address this, we present EPIC-Bench, Embodied PerceptIon BenChmark, a fine-grained grounding benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the visual perceptual capabilities of VLMs in real-world embodied environments. Comprising 6.6k meticulously annotated tuples (Image, Text, Mask), EPIC-Bench spans 23 fine-grained tasks across three core stages of the embodied interaction pipeline: Target Localization, Navigation, and Manipulation. Extensive evaluations of over 89 leading VLMs reveal that while advanced reasoning models show promise, current VLMs universally struggle with complex visual-text alignment for physical interactions. Specifically, models exhibit critical bottlenecks in multi-target counting, part-whole relationship understanding, and affordance region detection. EPIC-Bench provides a robust foundation and actionable insights for advancing the next generation of vision-driven embodied models.

</details>


### [120] [The Learnability Gap in Medical Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17087)
*Mischa Dombrowski,Felix Nützel,Bernhard Kainz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现并形式化了医学影像生成数据增强中的"可学习性鸿沟"：预训练自编码器的潜在空间虽然保留了判别性特征，但其结构方式导致分类器难以学习。通过五个自编码器家族和四个医学基准测试，证明该鸿沟普遍存在，并开发了噪声条件潜在分类器来探测和部分缩小这一差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于潜在扩散模型的生成式数据增强方法侧重于感知保真度和领域特定的自编码器微调，却忽视了一个更根本的瓶颈——潜在空间中特征的可学习性问题。

Method: 1) 形式化定义"可学习性鸿沟"；2) 在五个自编码器家族、四个医学影像基准（胸片、皮肤镜、CT、超声）上进行系统性评估；3) 开发带有FiLM层的噪声条件潜在分类器，结合图像空间蒸馏来探测和缩小差距。

Result: 可学习性鸿沟在不同架构、初始化策略和超参数下普遍存在，且医学领域微调无法消除；提出的方法实现了64倍吞吐量和120倍内存增益，同时作为潜在空间质量的诊断工具。

Conclusion: 潜在空间的结构（而非保真度或领域特异性）是缩小真实与合成医学训练数据性能差距的主要障碍，为评估自编码器潜在空间提供了新框架。

Abstract: Generative data augmentation with latent diffusion models is a promising strategy for addressing class imbalance in medical imaging, yet current approaches focus on perceptual fidelity and domain-specific autoencoder fine-tuning while neglecting a more fundamental bottleneck. We identify and formalize the learnability gap: large-scale pretrained autoencoders faithfully encode discriminative features for medical classification, as evidenced by near-lossless performance in reconstruction space, yet their latent representations are structured in ways that are difficult for classifiers to learn from. Across five autoencoder families and four medical benchmarks spanning chest radiography, dermatoscopy, computed tomography, and echocardiography, we show that this gap persists regardless of architecture, initialization strategy, or hyperparameter tuning, and that medical-domain fine-tuning of the autoencoder does not close it. To probe and partially narrow the gap, we develop noise-conditioned latent classifiers with FiLM layers and image-space distillation that offer 64x throughput and 120x memory gains over image-space models while serving as diagnostic tools for latent space quality. Our analysis provides a new framework for evaluating autoencoder latent spaces and identifies their structure, rather than their fidelity or domain specificity, as the primary obstacle to closing the performance gap between real and synthetic medical training data.

</details>


### [121] [HEED: Density-Weighted Residual Alignment for Hybrid Vision-Language Model Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17093)
*Yihao Liang,Niraj K. Jha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉语言模型蒸馏到混合架构（如3:1 Mamba-2/注意力）时，虽然整体基准测试表现良好，但在OCR和文档任务上严重退化。原因在于均匀的残差对齐损失过度关注低信息背景块，而忽略了携带关键文本信息的高密度块。作者提出HEED方法，用密度加权的残差对齐替代均匀加权，无需额外参数和推理成本，在OCRBench v2上提升8.7分，10基准平均提升5.13分，最终达到教师模型水平且吞吐量提升4.12倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法在混合架构上虽然整体基准表现不错，但隐蔽地失败于OCR和文档任务（下降13个点），因为均匀损失权重忽略了承载关键文本信息的高密度图像块。

Method: 提出HEED（密度加权残差对齐），利用图像块自不相似度作为无需训练的注意力代理，对高信息密度块给予更高权重，替代传统的均匀残差对齐损失。

Result: OCRBench v2提升8.7分，10基准平均提升5.13分。经过标准后训练后，学生模型在10基准平均达到教师水平，吞吐量提升4.12倍，128k上下文节省68%内存，无额外参数和推理成本。

Conclusion: 均匀权重蒸馏在细粒度文本任务上存在系统性缺陷，通过简单的密度加权即可有效恢复性能，表明对位置重要性的差异化处理对视觉语言模型蒸馏至关重要。

Abstract: Distilling vision-language models into faster hybrid architectures, such as 3:1 Mamba-2/attention mixes, is now standard practice for making inference efficient. Aggregate benchmarks suggest that this works but they hide selective failures. When we distill Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct into a 3:1 Mamba-2/attention hybrid, student model stays within 2 points of the teacher across visual reasoning benchmarks like MMStar, MMBench, and MMMU-Pro, while dropping 13 points on optical-character-recognition and document tasks. The student can still understand the scene but loses the fine-grained text needed to answer. We localize much of the failure to a specific kind of position. In a high-resolution image, most patches are sky, wall, or smooth texture, while a small fraction carries text, edges, object boundaries, or other local details. In a token-level diagnostic, the top 10% highest-density patches have 3.6$\times$ larger residual drift than the bottom 10% lowest-density patches and 3.5$\times$ larger teacher-masking answer contribution. Uniform weighting devotes many loss terms to low-information background patches, whereas sparse answer-bearing patches receive no special protection. The required intervention is minimal: we replace uniform residual alignment with density-weighted residual alignment, using patch self-dissimilarity as a training-free proxy for position importance. We call this HEED. Compared with normal end-to-end distillation, HEED increases performance by 8.7 points on OCRBench v2 and 5.13 points on a 10-benchmark average. The gain is realized on different teacher models and hybrid architectures. After standard post-training, the student reaches teacher-level performance on the 10-benchmark average with a 4.12$\times$ throughput and a 68% memory saving at 128k context, with no additional parameters and no inference-time cost.

</details>


### [122] [Visual Timelines of Police Encounters in Body-Worn Camera Footage: Operational Context and Activity Cataloging for Training and Analysis in OpenBWC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17095)
*Angela Srbinovska,Christopher Homan,Adrian Martin,Ernest Fokoué*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对执法记录仪(BWC)视频进行自动化分析的方法，将视频分割为10秒窗口，并从"操作上下文"和"运动强度"两个维度进行标注，帮助执法机构快速定位关键事件，准确率达78.75%-88.33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 执法记录仪积累了海量视频数据，但目前完全依赖人工逐帧观看，分析师和培训人员需要花费大量时间才能找到关键事件和活动强度转变点，亟需自动化分析手段。

Method: 将BWC视频分割为10秒时间对齐窗口，每个窗口从两个维度标注：(1)操作上下文；(2)运动强度。对于黑暗、模糊、遮挡等证据不足的情况标注为低置信度。使用CLIP模型编码帧级特征并聚合为窗口级表示，同时提取稠密光流统计量捕获运动强度。

Result: 上下文分类模型最佳准确率78.75%，运动强度分类模型最佳准确率88.33%。通过完整性审计验证了结果，视觉时间线表示能够加速事件审查并优化培训工作流程。

Conclusion: 该方法能够有效自动化分析BWC视频，支持更快速的事件审查和更实用的警员培训工作流，且采用了隐私保护协议。

Abstract: Law enforcement agencies are accumulating vast amounts of body-worn camera (BWC) footage. However, this remains operationally opaque. That is, analysts and trainers still have to invest considerable time watching full-length videos to pinpoint the start of key encounters and identify the points where activity shifts to something more physically intense. We present an approach to process BWC video into a time-aligned sequence of fixed-length 10-second windows, processed and labeled using a privacy-conscious protocol. Each window is labeled with two dimensions of information: (i) the operational context of the window and (ii) the level of motion intensity within the window, with low-evidence labels for windows for which insufficient evidence exists due to darkness, blur or occlusion. We train models to classify windows based on these two axes using frames sampled from each window encoded using CLIP model and aggregated into a window-level representation. We extract dense optical flow statistics for each window to capture motion intensity. On test windows the best context model achieves 78.75% accuracy, and the best-accuracy activity model achieves 88.33%. We also included integrity audits to show the results and how the visual timeline representations support faster incident review and make the officer training workflow more practical.

</details>


### [123] [Markerless Motion Capture for Biomechanical Whole-Body Kinematic Estimation in Infants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17120)
*Divya Joshi,J. D. Peiffer,Colleen Peyton,R. James Cotton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了三种3D姿态估计框架（MeTRAbs-ACAE、SAM 3D Body和Sapiens）在婴儿自发运动视频中的表现。Sapiens在重投影误差和几何一致性上最优，而SAM 3D Body提供了最完整的3D信息用于运动学重建。初步验证了基于视频的婴儿运动评估的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿运动障碍的早期识别依赖专家视觉评估，缺乏客观、可扩展的自动化方法。本研究旨在通过计算机视觉技术，系统评估现有姿态估计框架在婴儿运动分析中的适用性，推动视频驱动的早期运动发育评估。

Method: 收集8名婴儿的100段多视角视频（13次实验），使用三种姿态估计框架（MeTRAbs-ACAE、SAM 3D Body、Sapiens）进行3D姿态估计。通过重投影误差、几何一致性和Procrustes对齐的3D位置误差量化关键点检测精度，并拟合逆运动学框架进行案例比较分析。

Result: Sapiens表现最优：重投影误差22.8像素，几何一致性0.82。SAM 3D Body提供最全面的3D信息，Procrustes对齐位置误差19-28 mm。案例表明，基于SAM 3D估计的生物力学模型能够区分临床专家识别的代表性运动模式。

Conclusion: 三种框架各有优劣，3D姿态估计在婴儿生物力学分析中展现出潜力，但仍存在局限性。研究为大规模、基于视频的早期运动发育评估奠定了初步基础。

Abstract: arly identification of motor impairment in infancy relies on expert visual assessment of spontaneous movement, motivating the development of automated, objective alternatives. One promising approach is using computer vision, which benefits from high quality pose estimation from video. In this study, we systematically evaluated three state-of-the-art pose estimation frameworks (MeTRAbs-ACAE, SAM 3D Body, and Sapiens) on 100 videos over 13 sessions of 8 infants recorded with a multi-view markerless motion capture system. We quantified keypoint detection accuracy using reprojection error, geometric consistency, and Procrustes-aligned 3D position error, and demonstrated proof-of-concept for fitting an inverse kinematic framework to infant data. While Sapiens achieved the lowest reprojection error and highest geometric consistency of the methods evaluated (22.8 pixels and 0.82, respectively), SAM 3D Body provided the most comprehensive 3D information for kinematic reconstruction with Procrustes-aligned position errors of 19 to 28 mm. We demonstrate in a case comparison example that biomechanical models fit to SAM 3D estimates distinguish representative movement patterns in infants related to motor development, as identified by a clinical expert. Together, these findings highlight both the promise and current limitations of 3D pose estimation for infant biomechanics and establish preliminary groundwork for scalable, video-based assessment of early motor development.

</details>


### [124] [Principal Component Analysis for Lunar Crater Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17125)
*Travis Driver,John A. Christian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 EigenCrater 方法，基于主成分分析生成自动化陨石坑模板，用于月球轨道器与着陆器的光学导航，在手选模板上展现出更优的检测与位置估计性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月球光学导航中，基于图像的陨石坑识别技术因月球表面陨石坑丰富且拥有大量陨石坑目录而具有潜力。模板匹配因陨石坑形态相对均质而被认为是一种有前景的识别方法，但人工选取模板效率低且不够优化，因此需要自动化的模板生成方法。

Method: 提出 EigenCrater 方法，利用主成分分析（PCA）对陨石坑数字高程模型（DEM）进行分析，自动生成陨石坑识别模板。

Result: 在模拟月球图像上，EigenCrater 相比人工挑选的模板在检测性能和位置估计精度上均表现更优。

Conclusion: EigenCrater 是一种有效的自动化陨石坑模板生成方法，能够提升月球光学导航中基于模板匹配的识别与定位性能。

Abstract: Optical navigation is a critical component for lunar orbiter and lander missions. Image-based crater identification has emerged as a promising technology for optical navigation due to the abundance of craters on the lunar surface and the availability of extensive crater catalogs. Moreover, due to the relative morphological homogeneity among lunar craters, template matching has been identified as a promising approach for identification. In this paper, we propose EigenCrater, an automated crater template generation method based on principal component analysis of crater digital elevation maps (DEMs). We demonstrate superior detection and position estimation performance relative to hand-picked templates on simulated lunar imagery.

</details>
