Motivation: 现有评估仅孤立比较各地球嵌入模型的下游任务表现，忽略了空间对齐的嵌入天然可融合、提供更丰富信息的潜力。

Method: 提出嵌入互补性指数（embedding complementarity index），评估四种模型（AlphaEarth, Tessera, GeoCLIP, SatCLIP）在六项下游任务上的单独、两两及联合性能。

Result: 融合嵌入在4/6任务中优于最佳单模型；互补性具有任务和位置依赖性；对于土地覆盖回归任务，互补性部分由地物类别的空间尺度决定。

Conclusion: 地球嵌入的最大未来增益可能不来自任何单一模型，而来自模型的组合——"在一起更好"。

Abstract: Earth embedding models transform Earth observation data into embeddings uniquely tied to locations on the Earth's surface. These models are typically evaluated in isolation, comparing the downstream task performance across different Earth embeddings. However, spatially aligned embeddings can naturally be fused, providing richer information per location, a capability that isolated evaluations fail to capture. We therefore propose assessing Earth embeddings by their complementarity: the performance gain of fused embeddings over the best single-model baseline. To operationalise this, we introduce an embedding complementarity index applicable to any embedding and task, and evaluate four Earth embedding models (AlphaEarth, Tessera, GeoCLIP, SatCLIP) in isolation, in all pairs, and jointly across six downstream tasks. Fused embeddings outperform the best single model in four out of six tasks, confirming that single-embedding evaluations often underestimate Earth embedding capabilities. Complementarity proves both task- and location-dependent. Further, for a land cover regression task, we find that complementarity is partially determined by the spatial scale of land cover classes. Complementarity reframes Earth embeddings: the greatest future gains may come not from any single Earth embedding model, but from combinations that are better together.

</details>


### [306] [CMAG: Concept-Scaffolded Retrieval for Marketplace Avatar Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18680)
*Rajeev Goel,Jason Ding,Phani Harish Wajjala,Pavan Turaga,Tejaswi Gowda,Krishna C. Garikipati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CMAG提出了一种基于概念支架检索与验证的组合框架，用于在元宇宙市场中根据文本描述生成风格一致、拓扑兼容的3D虚拟形象，解决了文本检索的歧义性与组件不兼容问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元宇宙平台中的虚拟形象由分类标签化的3D资产（如上衣、裤子、鞋子等）组装而成，但用户日益期望使用自由文本进行控制。然而纯文本检索存在三方面问题：自然语言对平台分类体系存在歧义、元数据嘈杂或不规范、独立检索的组件在风格上不一致或几何上不兼容。

Method: CMAG包含四个核心模块：(1) 3D概念支架合成——生成中间3D表征以消除文本歧义，提供全局空间与风格上下文；(2) 视图感知部件发现——通过提示分解与基于文本的分割提取局部视觉证据；(3) 提示条件化的分类路由——强制类别覆盖并解决语义到分类的映射错配；(4) 混合类别检索——结合部件融合与基于特征抑制的概念残差回退；(5) 代理式视觉-语言模型——跨类别筛选重排候选，并通过迭代验证循环组装出忠实于提示且拓扑一致的虚拟形象。

Result: 在多种组合提示上的实验表明，CMAG相比强基线方法在检索鲁棒性和组合正确性上均有提升，验证了3D概念支架在提示歧义条件下对性能提升的重要性。

Conclusion: CMAG通过引入中间3D概念支架有效缓解了文本到3D资产检索中的歧义与不一致问题，为元宇宙平台中基于文本驱动的虚拟形象生成提供了更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Metaverse platforms rely on creator-driven marketplaces where avatars are assembled from discrete, taxonomy-labeled 3D assets (e.g., tops, bottoms, shoes, accessories) under strict category and topology constraints. While users increasingly expect free-form text control, text-only retrieval is brittle: natural language is ambiguous with respect to platform taxonomies, metadata is often noisy or informal, and independently retrieved components can be stylistically inconsistent or geometrically incompatible. We propose \textbf{CMAG}, a concept-scaffolded retrieval and verified composition framework for marketplace avatar generation. Given a prompt, CMAG first synthesizes an intermediate 3D concept scaffold that disambiguates intent beyond text by providing global spatial and stylistic context. In parallel, a view-aware part discovery module extracts localized visual evidence via prompt decomposition and text-grounded segmentation. A prompt-conditioned taxonomy router enforces category coverage and resolves semantic-to-taxonomic mismatch, after which a hybrid category-wise retriever combines part-based fusion with a concept-residual fallback using feature suppression. Finally, an agentic vision--language model filters and re-ranks candidates across categories and drives an iterative verification loop to assemble prompt-faithful, topologically consistent avatars from catalog assets. We evaluate CMAG on diverse compositional prompts and demonstrate improved retrieval robustness and compositional correctness compared to strong baselines, highlighting the importance of 3D concept scaffolding under prompt ambiguity.

</details>


### [307] [A Large-Scale Study on the Accuracy vs Cost Trade-offs of Training and Evaluation Settings in Fine-Grained Image Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18700)
*Edwin Arkel Rios,Augusto Christian Surya,Oswin Gosal,Fernando Mikael,Mary Madeline Nicole,Kisoon Jang,Bo-Cheng Lai,Min-Chun Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过2000+实验系统研究了细粒度图像识别中骨干网络选择与精度-成本权衡，扩展了Counterfactual Attention Learning方法，提出跨图像判别区域混合增强和高效推理变体，发现仅训练时使用数据感知增强即可在无裁剪下达到高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有细粒度图像识别研究重视骨干网络选择，但忽视了不同训练和评估设置下的精度与成本权衡问题。

Method: 1) 基于CAL扩展跨图像判别区域混合增强；2) 提出仅评估时的高效变体，放弃判别性裁剪前向传播以降低推理成本；3) 在6种训练/评估设置、9个预训练骨干、17个数据集上进行2000+实验的大规模研究。

Result: 数据感知增强仅用于训练阶段即可使模型获得优异精度，无需推理时使用裁剪，显著降低推理成本。

Conclusion: 训练时数据感知增强足以达到高精度；高效评估变体在保持竞争力的同时大幅降低推理成本。

Abstract: Prior work on fine-grained image recognition (FGIR) has established the importance of the backbone selection, but has neglected the accuracy-vs-cost trade-offs under different training and evaluation settings. In this work we conduct a large-scale study with over 2000 experiments across 6 training and evaluation settings, 9 pretrained backbones, and 17 datasets. Preliminary observations on the effectiveness of data augmentation for fine-grained training motivate us to extend Counterfactual Attention Learning (CAL), a state-of-the-art method based on data-aware cropping and masking augmentations, with cross-image discriminative region mixing augmentation. We also propose an efficient evaluation-only variant that maintains competitive accuracy while reducing inference costs by forfeiting the forward pass on discriminative crops that is normally used by CAL and similar FGIR methods. Our results show that data-aware augmentations during training only can enable a model to achieve excellent accuracy even without crops, significantly reducing inference costs. To support future research we share our code and checkpoints at: \url{https://github.com/arkel23/FGIR-Backbones}

</details>


### [308] [SafeDiffusion-R1: Online Reward Steering for Safe Diffusion Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18719)
*Komal Kumar,Ankan Deria,Abhishek Basu,Fahad Shamshad,Hisham Cholakkal,Karthik Nandakumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在线强化学习框架SafeDiffusion-R1，利用GRPO和CLIP嵌入的转向奖励机制，无需监督数据即可安全对齐扩散模型，同时避免灾难性遗忘并提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型安全对齐方法依赖昂贵的监督数据（不安全文本-安全图像对或正/负图像对），且离线方法存在灾难性遗忘和生成质量下降问题，难以规模化。

Method: 采用在线策略强化学习框架，使用GRPO在正负文本提示上进行后训练；提出转向奖励机制，利用CLIP嵌入内在属性（将文本表示向正安全方向引导、远离负安全方向），无需专门训练安全/不安全奖励模型。

Result: 不适当内容从48.9%降至18.07%，裸体检测从646降至15；GenEval组合生成质量从42.08%提升至47.83%；在7种危害类别上实现跨域泛化SOTA。

Conclusion: 提出的在线强化学习方法有效解决了数据稀缺和模型退化问题，无需监督数据或奖励模型调优即可实现安全对齐与生成质量提升的双赢。

Abstract: Diffusion models have been widely studied for removing unsafe content learned during pre-training. Existing methods require expensive supervised data, either unsafe-text paired with safe-image groundtruth or negative/positive image pairs, making them impractical to scale. Furthermore, offline reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning approaches that generate synthetic data offline suffer from catastrophic forgetting, degrading generation quality. We propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that addresses both data scarcity and model degradation through post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on both negative and positive text prompts. To eliminate the need for fine-tuning specialized safe/unsafe reward models, we introduce a \textit{steering reward mechanism} that exploits an inherent property of CLIP embeddings: steering text representations toward positive safety directions and away from negative ones in the embedding space. Our online-policy approach enables the model to learn from diverse prompts, including explicit unsafe content, without catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces inappropriate content to 18.07\% (vs. 48.9\% for SD v1.4) and nudity detections to 15 (vs. 646 baseline) while improving compositional generation quality from 42.08\% to 47.83\% on GenEval. Remarkably, these safety gains generalize to out-of-domain unsafe prompts across seven harm categories, achieving state-of-the-art performance without supervised paired data or reward tuning. Github: https://github.com/MAXNORM8650/SafeDiffusion-R1.

</details>


### [309] [Advancing Narrative Long Video Generation via Training-Free Identity-Aware Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18733)
*Jinzhuo Liu,Jiangning Zhang,Wencan Jiang,Yabiao Wang,Dingkang Liang,Zhucun Xue,Ran Yi,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出IAMFlow，一个无需训练的身份感知记忆框架，通过显式建模实体身份解决自回归视频生成中的长期不一致和身份漂移问题，在NarraStream-Bench上超越最强基线2.56分，并实现1.39倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频生成方法在处理动态提示中的实体引用变化时，存在身份漂移、角色重复和属性丢失等问题，原因是基于预定义压缩策略或隐式注意力匹配的方式无法有效追踪实体身份。

Method: IAMFlow包含三个核心模块：(1) LLM从提示中提取实体及视觉属性并分配全局唯一ID；(2) VLM异步验证并从渲染帧中精炼属性，实现显式实体追踪；(3) 系统化的推理加速流水线（异步视觉验证、自适应提示过渡、模型量化）。同时提出NarraStream-Bench基准和三维评估协议。

Result: 在NarraStream-Bench上IAMFlow超越最强基线2.56分，在60秒多提示场景下比最高效基线快1.39倍。

Conclusion: IAMFlow证明了无需额外训练，通过显式身份建模和异步验证即可同时提升视频生成的一致性和效率。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation has improved rapidly in visual fidelity and interactivity, but it still suffers from long-term inconsistency and memory degradation. Most existing solutions either compress historical frames using predefined strategies or retrieve keyframes based on coarse implicit attention signals, both of which fail to handle evolving prompts with shifting entity references, leading to identity drift, character duplication, and attribute loss. To address this, we propose IAMFlow, a training-free identity-aware memory framework that explicitly models and tracks persistent entity identities, enabling consistent generation across prompt transitions. Specifically, an LLM extracts entities with visual attributes from each prompt and assigns unique global IDs for identity-aware memory, while a VLM asynchronously verifies and refines attributes from rendered frames, enabling explicit entity tracking in place of implicit similarity-based matching. To keep the proposed framework computationally practical, we design a systematic inference acceleration pipeline, including asynchronous visual verification, adaptive prompt transition, and model quantization, which achieves faster generation than existing baselines. Furthermore, we introduce NarraStream-Bench, a benchmark for narrative streaming video generation that features 324 multi-prompt scripts spanning six dimensions and a three-dimensional evaluation protocol that integrates both traditional metrics and multimodal large language model-based assessments. Extensive experiments show that IAMFlow, despite being training-free, achieves the best overall performance on NarraStream-Bench, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.56 points, while achieving a 1.39$\times$ speedup over the most efficient baseline in the 60-second multi-prompt setting.

</details>


### [310] [EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18734)
*Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Di Wen,Shaofang Quan,Chengzhi Wu,Jiaming Zhang,Kailun Yang,Kunyu Peng,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了EgoExoMem基准，用于跨视角（自我中心+外部视角）记忆推理，并设计了E²-Select帧选择方法，实验表明现有模型在该任务上表现有限（最高55.3%），而E²-Select达到58.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能主要依赖自我中心记忆，但不足以支持全面的时空推理。受人类从场域和观察者双视角回忆的启发，作者首次提出跨视角记忆推理基准，以探索双视角互补记忆线索。

Method: E²-Select：一种无需训练的帧选择方法，结合基于相关性的预算分配和每视角k-DPP采样，处理视角不对称性和跨视角时间一致性，用于同步自我-外部视频。

Result: 最佳多模态大模型仅达到55.3%，E²-Select达到58.2%的SOTA性能。分析揭示了问题框架与答案基础之间系统性视角偏好冲突。

Conclusion: 自我中心和外部视角提供互补记忆线索；跨视角记忆推理是一个新颖且具有挑战性的任务，现有模型远未解决。

Abstract: Egocentric memory is widely used in embodied intelligence, but it may be insufficient for comprehensive spatial-temporal reasoning. Inspired by human recall from both field and observer perspectives, we introduce EgoExoMem, the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos. EgoExoMem contains $2.6K$ high-quality MCQs across eight temporal, spatial, and cross-view QA types. To support dual-view retrieval, we propose E$^2$-Select, a training-free frame selection method for synchronized ego-exo videos. It combines relevance-based budget allocation with per-view k-DPP sampling to handle view asymmetry and cross-view temporal consistency. Experiments show that ego and exo views provide complementary memory cues, while existing MLLMs remain far from solving the benchmark: the best model reaches only $55.3\%$. E$^2$-Select achieves state-of-the-art performance of $58.2\%$ over frame-selection and RAG-based memory baselines. Further analysis reveals systematic view-preference conflicts between question framing and answer grounding, underscoring the novelty and challenge of cross-view memory reasoning.

</details>


### [311] [PIXLRelight: Controllable Relighting via Intrinsic Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18735)
*Miguel Farinha,Ronald Clark*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PIXLRelight 提出了一种前馈式单张图像重光照方法，通过共享的内在条件（反照率、漫反射着色和非漫反射残差）桥接物理渲染与神经合成，实现高效的任意PBR光照控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在光照控制有限（如仅文本或环境图）、逆渲染与正向渲染串联累积误差、或需要逐张图像优化计算成本高等问题。本文旨在实现物理可控、高质量且高效的单图像重光照。

Method: 训练时，将多光照照片分解为反照率、漫反射着色和非漫反射残差作为条件；推理时，从输入图粗建3D模型，在用户指定PBR光源下路径追踪渲染，计算相同的条件。基于Transformer的神经渲染器通过逐像素仿射调制应用目标光照，保留细节。

Result: 支持任意PBR风格光照控制，达到SOTA重光照质量，每张图像处理时间小于0.1秒。

Conclusion: PIXLRelight 成功将物理渲染与神经合成融合，实现了高效、高质量、物理可控的单图像重光照，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: We present PIXLRelight, a feed-forward approach for physically controllable single-image relighting. Existing methods either provide limited lighting control (e.g. through text or environment maps), accumulate errors when chaining inverse and forward rendering, or require costly per-image optimization. Our key idea is to bridge physically based rendering (PBR) and learned image synthesis through a shared intrinsic conditioning that can be obtained from either real photographs or PBR renders. At training time, paired multi-illumination photographs are decomposed into albedo, diffuse shading, and non-diffuse residuals, which condition the model. At inference time, the same conditioning is computed from a path-traced render of a coarse 3D reconstruction of the input under user-specified PBR lights. A transformer-based neural renderer then applies the target illumination to the source photograph, preserving fine image detail through a per-pixel affine modulation. PIXLRelight enables arbitrary PBR-style lighting control, achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality, and runs in under a tenth of a second per image. Code and models are available at https://mlfarinha.github.io/pixl-relight/.

</details>


### [312] [Spectral Progressive Diffusion for Efficient Image and Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18736)
*Howard Xiao,Brian Chao,Lior Yariv,Gordon Wetzstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频谱渐进扩散框架，利用扩散模型在频域中自回归生成的特点（低频先于高频），通过沿去噪轨迹渐进式增长分辨率来实现高效生成，无需训练即可加速，并支持微调优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在频域中隐式地自回归生成内容，低频成分在去噪早期生成，高频细节在后期出现。在早期噪声主导的频率上使用高分辨率计算存在大量冗余，因此希望利用这一结构特性实现高效生成。

Method: 提出Spectral Progressive Diffusion框架：(1) 频谱噪声扩展机制；(2) 从模型功率谱推导最优分辨率调度策略；(3) 支持无需训练的加速以及进一步微调的优化方案。

Result: 在多个最先进的预训练图像和视频生成模型上实现了显著的加速效果，同时保持视觉质量。

Conclusion: 利用扩散模型频域生成特性，通过渐进式分辨率增长实现高效生成，在加速的同时保证生成质量，是一种通用且有效的加速框架。

Abstract: Diffusion models have been shown to implicitly generate visual content autoregressively in the frequency domain, where low-frequency components are generated earlier in the denoising process while high-frequency details emerge only in later timesteps. This structure offers a natural opportunity for efficient generation, as high-resolution computation on noise-dominated frequencies is largely redundant. We propose Spectral Progressive Diffusion, a general framework that progressively grows resolution along the denoising trajectory of pretrained diffusion models. To this end, we develop a spectral noise expansion mechanism and derive an optimal resolution schedule from the model's power spectrum. Our framework supports training-free acceleration and a novel fine-tuning recipe that further improves efficiency and quality. We demonstrate significant speedups on state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generation models while preserving visual quality.

</details>


### [313] [LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18739)
*Yukang Chen,Luozhou Wang,Wei Huang,Shuai Yang,Bohan Zhang,Yicheng Xiao,Ruihang Chu,Weian Mao,Qixin Hu,Shaoteng Liu,Yuyang Zhao,Huizi Mao,Ying-Cong Chen,Enze Xie,Xiaojuan Qi,Song Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LongLive-2.0 提出了一套基于 NVFP4 精度的长视频生成训练与推理基础设施，通过序列并行自回归训练、NVFP4 精度加速、异步流式 VAE 解码等技术，在训练和推理上分别实现了最高 2.15 倍和 1.84 倍的加速，并在 5B 模型上达到 45.7 FPS 的推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频生成面临训练和推理时的速度瓶颈与显存瓶颈，现有方法依赖于 ODE 初始化与分布匹配蒸馏等复杂流程，缺乏高效的并行训练基础设施。

Method: 1) 提出 Balanced SP 序列并行自回归训练，将干净历史与噪声目标块配对，结合 NVFP4 精度减少显存并加速 GEMM；2) 直接微调扩散模型为长视频自回归扩散模型，无需 ODE 初始化与 DMD；3) 支持 4-2 步实时推理的 LoRA 权重；4) Blackwell GPU 上实现 W4A4 NVFP4 推理与 KV cache 量化；非 Blackwell GPU 上使用 SP 推理匹配速度。

Result: 训练加速最高 2.15 倍，推理加速最高 1.84 倍；LongLive-2.0-5B 达到 45.7 FPS 推理速度，并在多项基准上表现强劲。

Conclusion: LongLive-2.0 是首个面向长视频生成的 NVFP4 训练与推理系统，证明了高质量基础设施与数据集可以大幅简化训练流程，同时实现显著的加速效果。

Abstract: We present LongLive-2.0, an NVFP4-based parallel infrastructure throughout the full training and inference workflow of long video generation, addressing speed and memory bottlenecks. For training, we introduce sequence-parallel autoregressive (AR) training, instantiated as Balanced SP, which co-designs the efficient teacher-forcing layout with SP execution by pairing clean-history and noisy-target temporal chunks on each rank, enabling a natural teacher-forcing mask with SP-aware chunked VAE encoding. Combined with NVFP4 precision, it reduces GPU memory cost and accelerates GEMM computation during training, the proportion of which increases as video length grows. Moreover, we show that a high-quality infrastructure and dataset enable a remarkably clean training pipeline. Unlike existing Self-Forcing series methods that rely on ODE initialization and subsequent distribution matching distillation (DMD), LongLive-2.0 directly tunes a diffusion model into a long, multi-shot, interactive auto-regressive (AR) diffusion model. It can be further converted to real-time generation (4 to 2 denoising steps) with standalone LoRA weights. For inference on Blackwell GPUs, we enable W4A4 NVFP4 inference, quantize KV cache into NVFP4 for memory savings, and boost end-to-end throughput with asynchronous streaming VAE decoding. On non-Blackwell GPU architectures, we deploy SP inference to match the speed on Blackwell GPUs, while the quantized KV cache can lower inter-GPU communication of SP. Experiments show up to 2.15x speedup in training, and 1.84x in inference. LongLive-2.0-5B achieves 45.7 FPS inference while attaining strong performance on benchmarks. To our knowledge, LongLive-2.0 is the first NVFP4 training and inference system for long video generation.

</details>


### [314] [Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18748)
*Yongsheng Yu,Ziyun Zeng,Zhiyuan Xiao,Zhenghong Zhou,Hang Hua,Wei Xiong,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Aurora是一个智能体视频编辑框架，通过VLM智能体将用户模糊请求转化为结构化编辑计划，再交给统一扩散变压器执行，解决了现有视频编辑模型需要用户提供精确输入的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑模型虽然统一了多种编辑任务，但假设用户已经提供模型可直接使用的文本、参考图像和空间定位，而真实用户请求往往模糊、不完备，缺乏自动化处理用户原始需求的能力。

Method: 提出Aurora框架，核心是一个经过监督学习和偏好对训练的工具增强VLM智能体，它接收用户原始请求，自动生成与扩散变压器条件通道对齐的结构化编辑计划（包括文本、参考图像选择等），再由统一视频扩散变压器执行编辑。

Result: 在AgentEdit-Bench和两个现有视频编辑基准上，Aurora优于纯指令基线，且VLM智能体可迁移至其他兼容的冻结视频编辑模型。

Conclusion: Aurora通过智能体方式有效解决了视频编辑中用户需求的模糊性问题，提升了编辑框架的实用性和自动化程度。

Abstract: Recent video editing models have converged on a unified conditioning design: a single diffusion transformer jointly consumes text, source video, and reference images, and one set of weights covers replacement, removal, style transfer, and reference-driven insertion. The design is flexible, but it assumes that the user already provides model-ready text, reference images, and spatial grounding for local edits, which real requests often omit. We present Aurora, an agentic video editing framework that pairs a tool-augmented vision-language model (VLM) agent with a unified video diffusion transformer. The VLM agent maps a raw user request to a structured edit plan aligned with the transformer's conditioning channels, thereby resolving textual and visual underspecification before generation. We train the VLM agent with supervised data for complete edit planning and reference-image selection, together with preference pairs for robust tool use and instruction refinement. We introduce AgentEdit-Bench to evaluate agent-enhanced video editing under textual and visual underspecification. Experiments on AgentEdit-Bench and two existing video editing benchmarks show that Aurora improves over instruction-only baselines and that the VLM agent transfers to compatible frozen video editing models. Project page: https://yeates.github.io/Aurora-Page

</details>


### [315] [Can These Views Be One Scene? Evaluating Multiview 3D Consistency when 3D Foundation Models Hallucinate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18754)
*Soumava Paul,Prakhar Kaushik,Alan Yuille*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现现有多视图3D一致性评估指标（如MEt3R）在神经重建模型上存在可靠性问题——模型会为无意义输入（随机噪声、重复图像等）产生高分。作者通过引入鲁棒性基准测试、分解神经指标为三组件、提出基于COLMAP的故障感知指标，实现了比MEt3R高4倍的人类判断相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图3D一致性评估指标（如MEt3R）依赖神经重建骨干网络，但这些网络在各种异常输入（伪影、离群帧、重复视图、噪声）下的失败模式未被充分刻画，导致评估结果不可靠。因此需要系统研究并改进这些指标的鲁棒性。

Method: (1) 构建受控鲁棒性基准测试(ℬenchmark)；(2) 提出参数化指标族，将神经指标分解为骨干网络(backbone)、残差(residual)和聚合(aggregation)三个组件，恢复MEt3R并生成更鲁棒的变体；(3) 提出基于COLMAP的指标，利用匹配、配准、稠密支持和重建失败作为故障感知的一致性信号。

Result: (1) 参数化变体相比MEt3R鲁棒性提升高达3倍；(2) 发现VGGT、MASt3R等骨干网络会在无关场景、重复图像和随机噪声上"幻觉"出稠密几何和跨视图支持；(3) 基于COLMAP的指标在真实NVS输出和结构化人类研究上，与人类判断的相关性比MEt3R高4倍。

Conclusion: 神经重建骨干在异常输入下存在严重的幻觉问题，需要故障感知的评估方法。提出的COLMAP-based指标比纯神经指标更可靠地反映人类对3D一致性的判断，为该领域提供了更可信的评估工具。

Abstract: Multiview 3D evaluation assumes that the images being scored are observations of one static 3D scene. This assumption can fail in NVS and sparse-view reconstruction: inputs or generated outputs may contain artifacts, outlier frames, repeated views, or noise, yet still receive high 3D consistency scores. Existing reference-based metrics require ground truth, while ground-truth-free metrics such as MEt3R depend on learned reconstruction backbones whose failure modes are poorly characterized. We study this reliability problem by comparing neural reconstruction priors with classical geometric verification. We introduce \benchmark, a controlled robustness benchmark for multiview 3D consistency, and a parametric family that decomposes neural metrics into backbone, residual, and aggregation components. This family recovers MEt3R and yields variants up to $3\times$ more robust. Our analysis shows that VGGT, MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R can hallucinate dense geometry and cross-view support for unrelated scenes, repeated images, and random noise. We introduce COLMAP-based metrics that use matches, registration, dense support, and reconstruction failure as failure-aware consistency signals. On real NVS outputs and a structured human study, these metrics achieve up to $4\times$ higher correlation with human judgments than MEt3R.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [316] [Haptic Rendering of Fractional-Order Viscoelasticity: Passivity and Rendering Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16389)
*Gorkem Gemalmaz,Harun Tolasa,Volkan Patoglu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对分数阶粘弹性模型在有限记忆离散化下的无源性分析及触觉渲染性能进行了研究，推导了分数阶标准线性固体模型的无源性条件、有效刚度和阻尼表达式，并通过实验与用户评估验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉渲染中，粘弹性材料（如生物组织）表现出蠕变和应力松弛等时间依赖行为，需要准确建模。分数阶模型能以较少参数描述记忆效应，但其在有限记忆离散化下的无源性（确保触觉交互稳定）尚缺乏统一分析框架。

Method: 基于Grunwald-Letnikov导数对分数阶标准线性固体模型进行短记忆离散化，推导出闭合形式的无源性条件及有效刚度和阻尼的符号表达式，将结果推广至整数阶Kelvin-Voigt、Maxwell和SLS模型。

Result: 建立了统一的无源性条件框架，涵盖并推广了整数阶经典模型；通过实验验证了理论无源性边界，并进行了用户主观评估以验证分数阶模型感知上的真实性。

Conclusion: 本研究为分数阶粘弹性模型的触觉渲染提供了统一的理论框架和实验评估，确保了交互稳定性，并为实际应用（如医疗模拟）奠定了基础。

Abstract: Haptic rendering of viscoelastic materials that exhibit creep and stress relaxation is crucial for many applications, such as medical training with realistic biological tissue models. Fractional-order viscoelastic models provide an effective means of describing intrinsically time-dependent dynamics with few parameters, as these models can naturally capture memory effects. In this study, we present analyses of passivity and rendering performance for fractional-order viscoelastic models under finite-memory discretization. We derive closed-form expressions to ensure the passivity of haptic rendering with a fractional-order (FO) standard linear solid (SLS) model based on Grunwald-Letnikov derivative under short-memory discretization. We also provide symbolic expressions for the effective stiffness and damping of such FO-SLS models. The resulting passivity conditions constitute a unified framework that generalizes previously reported results for integer-order Kelvin-Voigt, Maxwell, and SLS models, since these results are special cases of the newly derived condition. Furthermore, we provide experimental validations of the theoretical passivity bounds and human-subject evaluations of perceived realism of FO-SLS models. Overall, this study establishes a unified theoretical framework and experimental evaluations for FO viscoelastic rendering under short-memory discretization.

</details>


### [317] [OrbiSim: World Models as Differentiable Physics Engines for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16395)
*Jiajian Li,Jingyuan Huang,Junru Gong,Qi Wang,Xiaokang Yang,Yunbo Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OrbiSim 提出了一种全新的机器人仿真范式，将世界模型重新定义为一个完全可微的物理引擎，支持端到端可微的仿真循环，在预测保真度和控制性能上显著优于现有世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型主要关注潜在空间或视觉域中的无约束想象，缺乏统一的、物理可微的仿真路径，无法支持接触建模、梯度策略优化等任务。

Method: 构建了一个完全可微的物理引擎，将结构化场景资产、神经动力学与下游强化学习统一在一个端到端可微的仿真回路中，涵盖从显式状态转换到视觉观测生成的整个过程。

Result: 在预测保真度和控制性能上显著超越当前最先进的世界模型，并且对资产配置和物理参数的变化保持一致的响应性。

Conclusion: OrbiSim 具有作为可微分工具的潜力，可用于增强机器人仿真和策略训练，尤其适用于传统仿真器难以处理的任务。

Abstract: We present OrbiSim, a novel robotic simulation paradigm that redefines world models as a fully differentiable physics engine for embodied intelligence. Unlike prior world models that focus on unconstrained imagination in latent or visual domains, OrbiSim establishes a unified, physically-grounded pathway that bridges structured scene assets, neural dynamics, and downstream reinforcement learning. By enabling end-to-end differentiability throughout the entire simulation loop -- spanning from explicit state transitions to visual observation generation -- OrbiSim supports tasks traditionally intractable for classical simulators, such as differentiable contact modeling, gradient-based policy optimization under sparse rewards, and intuitive physical inference. Empirical results demonstrate that OrbiSim significantly outperforms state-of-the-art world models in both predictive fidelity and control performance. Furthermore, its consistent responsiveness to asset configurations and physical parameters suggests its potential as a differentiable tool for enhancing robot simulation and policy training.

</details>


### [318] [Support-Safe Variational Hybrid Filtering for Contact-Mode and Sparse-Law Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16398)
*Marios Papamichalis,Regina Ruane*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VHYDRO是一种变分混合动力学学习器，通过支持覆盖的提议分布防止接触丰富机器人动力学中的分支丢失，联合推断连续潜状态和离散接触模式，并恢复稀疏端口-哈密顿定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的机器人动力学具有混合特性，标准滤波方法因无法对可行接触转移赋予概率而永久丢失机器人实际遵循的分支。

Method: VHYDRO在每个步骤中将学习到的提议与可行转移定律混合，进行采样和重要性加权；联合推断连续潜状态和离散接触模式；为每个恢复的模态拟合稀疏端口-哈密顿定律。

Result: 支持覆盖稳定了滤波；稳定滤波将离散接触后验集中于连贯模态；模态纯净段支持稀疏端口-哈密顿恢复。在严重遮挡下防御性滤波器仍可用；在多个机器人任务上离散状态形成时间连贯的接触模态段，优于基线；在已知混合系统上模态条件稀疏拟合恢复了主动物理项。

Conclusion: VHYDRO通过支持覆盖机制有效防止分支丢失，在复杂接触动力学场景下实现更鲁棒的混合状态估计和物理定律恢复。

Abstract: Contact-rich robot dynamics are hybrid: a single observation can match several latent states and contact regimes (free, impact, stick--slip). A standard amortized filter that places no probability on a feasible contact transition will permanently lose the branch the robot actually follows. We introduce VHYDRO, a variational hybrid dynamics learner that prevents this branch loss. At each step, VHYDRO mixes the learned proposal with a feasible transition law before sampling and importance weighting, ensuring that every transition retained by the model-feasible carrier remains covered. VHYDRO jointly infers a continuous latent state and a discrete contact mode, and fits a sparse port-Hamiltonian law to each recovered regime. On top of this, three guarantees connect: support coverage stabilizes filtering, the stabilized filter concentrates the discrete contact posterior on coherent regimes, and mode-pure segments admit sparse port-Hamiltonian recovery. The recovery error separates cleanly into filtering, derivative, mode-impurity, and physics-residual parts. Three empirical findings track the same mechanism. Under heavy occlusion the support-safe filter stays usable while a non-defensive proposal collapses. On ManiSkill demonstrations and on four Sawyer/BridgeData task families the discrete state forms temporally coherent contact-regime segments that the discrete state yields a stronger joint profile across ARI, change-point F1, and segment purity than post-hoc and mode-free baselines. On hybrid systems with known equations the mode-conditioned sparse fit recovers the active physical terms; purely predictive baselines do not.

</details>


### [319] [SCAR: Self-Supervised Continuous Action Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16412)
*Hongjia Liu,Fan Feng,Minghao Fu,Xinyue Wang,Haofei Lu,Biwei Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SCAR框架，通过联合逆向前向动力学模型，从视觉变迁中学习跨本体的统一动作表征，使动作成为可控变化的共享表示接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型难以在有限数据下跨本体泛化，动作仅被视为辅助条件信号而非独立表征因子，缺乏从视觉变迁中学习可迁移动作表征的能力。

Method: 基于预训练生成骨干，构建联合逆向前向动力学框架：逆动力学模型从潜空间观测对推断潜在动作，前向动力学模型据此预测未来动态；通过高斯先验正则化限制任意视觉编码，引入对抗不变性抑制本体与环境干扰因子。

Result: 在Procgen和Robotwin数据集上，学习的统一潜在动作表征作为世界模型的条件接口优于本体特定原始动作，实现跨本体低数据适应和跨任务迁移的提升。

Conclusion: 动作可作为跨本体的可控变化共享表征进行学习，为更可迁移和可泛化的世界模型提供接口。

Abstract: Despite the central role of action in embodied intelligence, learning transferable action representations from visual transitions remains a fundamental challenge, particularly when world models must generalize across embodiments under limited data. We argue that action is not merely an auxiliary conditioning signal, but a distinct representational factor that decouples the controllable change from embodiment-specific actuation. In this work, we propose SCAR, a joint inverse-forward dynamics framework for learning unified action representations across embodiments from visual transitions. Built on a pretrained generative backbone, SCAR uses an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to infer latent actions from latent observation pairs and a forward dynamics model (FDM) to predict future dynamics conditioned on them. To make the latent space transferable rather than a generic visual bottleneck, we regularize the latent action posterior toward a standard Gaussian prior to limit arbitrary visual encoding, and introduce adversarial invariance to suppress embodiment- and environment-specific nuisance factors. Experiments on the Procgen and Robotwin dataset show that the learned unified latent action representation serves as a stronger conditioning interface for world modeling than embodiment-specific raw actions, yielding improved cross-embodiment low-data adaptation and cross-task transfer. Taken together, these results suggest that action can be learned as a shared representation of controllable change across embodiments, providing an interface for more transferable and generalizable world models.

</details>


### [320] [MR-SLAM: Immersive Spatial Supervision for Multi-Robot Mapping via Mixed Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16432)
*Prakash Aryan,Cem Erdogdu,Kavinaya Kumarchokkappan,Timo Kehrer,Sebastiano Panichella*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MR-SLAM系统，利用混合现实（Meta Quest 3头显）让操作员通过透视视图远程操控三台TurtleBot3机器人进行多机器人SLAM，系统在ROS 2后端实时合并占据栅格地图，实验显示扫描频率8.83Hz、建图面积17.9m²、跨机器人一致性94.7%，作为消费级硬件上透视MR监督与多机器人SLAM结合的参考实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统2D界面在监控多机器人SLAM时（如建筑巡检、仓库走廊监测）难以有效保持对每个机器人位置和建图状态的空间感知，操作员认知负荷高，扩展性差。

Method: 操作员佩戴Meta Quest 3头显，通过透视视图（带真实世界遮挡）远程操控三台模拟TurtleBot3机器人；每个机器人运行独立SLAM Toolbox实例，ROS 2后端实时合并占据栅格地图；空间锚定仪表板原位报告建图进度。

Result: 五次9分钟评估：扫描频率8.83±0.16Hz，建图面积17.9±0.8m²，跨机器人占据一致性94.7±0.5%；额外测试：变换抖动中位数6.3ms，覆盖面积26.7m²（总网格41m²）。

Conclusion: MR-SLAM可作为在消费级硬件上结合透视混合现实监督与多机器人SLAM的参考实现。

Abstract: Operating a multi-robot fleet for simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) in applications such as building inspection or warehouse-aisle monitoring requires the operator to maintain spatial awareness of each robot's position and mapping state, a task that scales poorly on conventional 2D interfaces. We present MR-SLAM, a mixed reality (MR) system in which an operator wearing a Meta Quest 3 headset teleoperates three simulated TurtleBot3 robots through a passthrough view with real-world occlusion, while spatially anchored dashboard panels report mapping progress in situ. Each robot runs an independent SLAM Toolbox instance whose occupancy grid is merged in real time on a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) back end. Across five 9-minute evaluation sessions, the system delivered scans at 8.83 +/- 0.16 Hz, mapped 17.9 +/- 0.8 m^2 of merged occupancy, and reached 94.7 +/- 0.5% cross-instance occupancy consistency across robot pairs. An additional session recorded 6.3 ms median transform jitter and 26.7 m^2 coverage of a 41 m^2 grid. We position MR-SLAM as a reference implementation for combining passthrough mixed reality supervision with multi-robot SLAM on consumer hardware.

</details>


### [321] [Hierarchical Two-Stage Framework for Environment-Aware Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16442)
*Ganeshaaraj Gnanavel,Tharindu Fernando,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层两阶段框架，结合粗粒度长期预测器与网格感知短期预测器，并集成环境模块（海流、风、波浪）及可学习的Savitzky-Golay平滑层，在澳大利亚CTS数据集上实现10小时船舶轨迹预测，ADE提升25%，FDE提升17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域船舶轨迹预测对碰撞规避、交通管理和航线规划至关重要，但现有方法难以处理长时间依赖和动态海洋环境因素（海流、风、波浪）的影响。

Method: 提出分层两阶段框架：1）粗粒度长期预测器编码全局航行意图；2）网格感知短期预测器使用时空图Transformer在离散化海事单元上捕捉局部动态；3）分层融合机制结合两者；4）环境模块通过跨模态注意力与特征调制集成海流、风、波高参数；5）可学习Savitzky-Golay平滑层增强时间一致性。

Result: 在澳大利亚西北海域CTS数据集及Copernicus海洋数据上，以3小时输入预测10小时轨迹，ADE提升25%，FDE提升17%，消融实验验证各组件有效性。

Conclusion: 所提分层融合框架有效提升了长时域船舶轨迹预测精度，环境模块和平滑层对性能提升有显著贡献。

Abstract: Long-horizon vessel trajectory forecasting under real ocean conditions is critical for collision avoidance, traffic management, and route planning. However, achieving accurate predictions is challenging due to long-range temporal dependencies and dynamic environmental factors such as currents, wind, and waves. To address these issues, we propose a hierarchical two-stage framework that combines a coarse long-term predictor with a grid-aware short-term predictor through a hierarchical fusion mechanism. The short-term branch leverages a Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer on discretized maritime cells to capture localized dynamics, while the long-term branch encodes overarching navigational intent. An integrated environmental module incorporates oceanographic parameters, including surface currents, wind vectors, and significant wave height, using cross-modal attention and feature-wise modulation for adaptive response to varying sea conditions. Additionally, a learnable Savitzky-Golay smoothing layer enhances temporal coherence in fused trajectories. We evaluate our approach on Australian Craft Tracking System (CTS) data from the North West region, aligned with Copernicus Marine Service products, using a 3-hour input and a 10-hour prediction horizon. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms the state-of-the-art by 25% in Average Displacement Error (ADE) and 17% in Final Displacement Error (FDE). Ablation studies further validate the contribution of each component.

</details>


### [322] [No Plan, Yet Human: A Reactive Robotics Model Predicts Human Planning Failures on a Clinical Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16514)
*Michael Migacev,Vito Mengers,Antonia Köngeter,Oliver Brock*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文应用原本为机器人操控开发的反应式梯度下降框架AICON来模拟伦敦塔测试，发现AICON能够复现人类在24个问题上的难度排序，并优于结构任务参数和规划基线模型。**关键发现**：AICON在模拟规划能力受限群体（如帕金森患者）时表现更好，而规划基线模型则更好地模拟健康对照组，这一分离现象与AICON原始论文的预测一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解为什么某些序列规划问题比其他问题更难，需要能够捕捉具体问题难度模式的模型，且理想情况下应在规划能力受限时以与人类相同的方式失败。

Method: 将机器人领域开发的AICON（反应式梯度下降框架）应用于伦敦塔测试（认知测试），不依赖任何前瞻性规划或人类认知知识，评估其在24个问题上的表现。

Result: AICON复现了人类精细的难度排序，优于结构任务参数；在留二评估中泛化到新问题；在模拟规划能力受限群体时优于规划基线，而规划基线更好地捕捉健康对照组。

Conclusion: 随着规划能力降低，人类行为向AICON建模的反应模式转变。AICON——最初为机器人学构建——现在能够捕捉跨感知、眼动和序列规划的生物学行为，表明其核心抽象反映了生物系统组织的某种真实特征。

Abstract: Understanding why some sequential planning problems are harder than others requires models that go beyond average performance. They should capture the specific pattern of which problems are hard, and ideally fail in the same way people do when planning capacity is reduced. We apply AICON, a reactive gradient-descent framework developed for robotic manipulation, to the Tower of London test, a cognitive test used to assess planning in Parkinson's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and stroke. Without any lookahead planning or knowledge of human cognition, AICON reproduces the fine-grained human difficulty ordering across 24 problems better than structural task parameters and generalizes to held-out problems in a leave-two-out evaluation. Crucially, AICON outperforms a planning baseline for groups with reduced planning capacity while the planning baseline better captures healthy controls. This dissociation was predicted by the original AICON paper, which noted that the model's failure modes resemble those of Parkinson's patients who struggle with goal hierarchies but not move counts. This suggests that as planning capacity is reduced, human behavior shifts toward the reactive mode AICON models. The finding extends a broader pattern: AICON, originally built for robotics, now captures aspects of biological behavior across perception, eye movements, and sequential planning, suggesting its core abstraction reflects something real about how biological systems are organized.

</details>


### [323] [A Mechanistic Model for Collective Motion from Sensorimotor Regularities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16522)
*Vito Mengers,Bao Duc Cao,Oliver Brock*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于机器人学的集体运动模型，每个个体通过有限视野内的方位和表观大小感知邻居，利用梯度下降选择行动，无需预设交互力，即可涌现出极化、环状等多样集体行为。全局敏感性分析表明，行为转变由可测量的生物参数（视野几何、感官噪声、转向敏捷度、记忆）决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自驱动粒子模型是描述性的，无法解释集体行为产生的底层机制；且实证发现如蝗虫并不与邻居对齐，表明需要基于感知-运动机制的机械论模型。

Method: 基于机器人学框架，扩展至集体运动：每个智能体通过方位和表观大小在有限视野内感知邻居，维护不确定的内部状态估计，并通过期望社会距离上的梯度下降选择行动，无预设交互力。

Result: 模型产生了极化运动、旋转、环状结构、子群分裂等多种集体行为。全局敏感性分析发现行为转变由视野几何、感官噪声、转向敏捷度和记忆等可测量的生物参数控制。

Conclusion: 集体行为可以理解为相互作用的感知-运动规律涌现的结果，不同物种间的差异可以归结为身体结构和环境差异的涌现结果。

Abstract: Collective behavior in animals has long been modeled through self-propelled particle models, which reproduce striking group-level phenomena through abstract interaction forces. Yet these models are fundamentally descriptive: they leave open the question of how collective behavior is actually produced. Recent empirical work makes this gap concrete: locusts do not align with neighbors, sensory and cognitive mechanisms mediate interaction instead. A mechanistic model must therefore operate at the sensorimotor level, grounded in what individual organisms can actually perceive, estimate, and physically execute. We present such a model based on a modeling framework from robotics, extended here to collective motion. Each agent perceives neighbors through bearing and apparent-size cues within a limited field of view, maintains uncertain internal state estimates, and selects actions through gradient descent on a desired social distance -- without any prescribed interaction forces. This simple model produces diverse collective behaviors including polarized motion, milling, ring formations, and subgroup fragmentation. A global sensitivity analysis shows that behavioral transitions are governed by sensorimotor parameters corresponding to measurable biological quantities: field of view geometry, sensory noise, turning agility, and memory. Collective behavior can therefore be understood as the emergent outcome of interacting sensorimotor regularities, and differences across species as the emergent outcome of differences in embodiment and environment.

</details>


### [324] [Nori Bot: A Sub-$1,000 Floor-to-Counter Mobile Manipulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16537)
*Antonio Li,Sungjoon Park,Wen Ni Chew*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Nori Bot是一款仅需947美元、拥有17个自由度的双臂移动操作平台，通过升降机构、主动代理运行环境和软TPU手指安全机制，解决了低价移动操作平台在高度固定、控制被动和伺服电机烧毁方面的三大局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低价（<1000美元）移动操作平台存在三个共同局限：固定高度工作空间、仅支持被动反应式控制、缺乏防止廉价Feetech伺服电机因堵转而烧毁的保护机制。作者旨在设计一款既保持低成本又能解决上述所有问题的平台。

Method: (1) 在现有伺服总线上集成600mm Z轴升降机构，实现从地面到台面的操作范围；(2) 采用树莓派4作为瘦客户端，搭配OpenClaw主动代理运行时环境，通过cron作业和钩子实现自主物理任务触发；(3) 通过电机电流实现无传感器夹持力反馈，配合软TPU手指构成软件安全堆栈，防止伺服电机烧毁。

Result: 成功构建了成本仅947美元（约为同类商用平台的3%）的17自由度双臂移动操作平台Nori Bot，同时解决了固定高度、被动控制和电机烧毁三大问题。

Conclusion: Nori Bot证明了低成本移动操作平台也能实现升降机构、主动控制和电机保护，代码、CAD文件和技能清单将开源发布，为低成本的移动操作研究提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Open-source mobile manipulators have reached $660 (XLeRobot) but every sub-$1,000 platform shares three limitations: a fixed-height workspace, reactive-only control, and no protection against the stall-induced burn-out that destroys cheap Feetech servos. We present Nori Bot, a 17-DoF dual-arm mobile manipulator at $947 (~3% the cost of comparable commercial platforms) that addresses all three: (1) a 600mm Z-axis lift on the existing servo bus for floor-to-counter reach; (2) a thin-client Raspberry Pi 4 paired with the OpenClaw proactive agent runtime so cron jobs and hooks trigger physical tasks autonomously; and (3) a software safety stack with sensorless grip-force feedback via motor current on a soft TPU finger. Code, CAD, and the skill manifest will be released.

</details>


### [325] [Policy Library CBF: Finite-Horizon Safety at Runtime via Parallel Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16588)
*Taekyung Kim,Hideki Okamoto,Bardh Hoxha,Georgios Fainekos,Dimitra Panagou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出策略库控制障碍函数（PL-CBF），通过并行有限水平滚动评估多个应急策略并选择最优安全模式，在复杂动态环境中实现毫秒级在线安全认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键自主系统在非结构化环境中面临在线安全认证的挑战，传统单一策略安全滤波器在约束动态变化时覆盖率不足。

Method: 构建策略库（包含多个应急策略），通过并行有限水平滚动评估各策略行为，选择最不侵入的安全模式，并利用二次规划最小化修改名义策略，同时提供基于有限水平语言度量的理论覆盖性分析。

Result: 在平面双积分器（4状态）、高速公路摩擦突变（8状态非线性车辆模型）和三维四旋翼密集动态导航（12状态）中验证，相比单一策略滤波器安全覆盖率显著提升，且保持毫秒级实时性。

Conclusion: PL-CBF通过策略库多样化覆盖和并行评估机制，在不牺牲实时性的前提下有效提升了复杂动态环境下的安全认证能力。

Abstract: Safety-critical autonomy in unstructured environments poses significant challenges for online safety certification under evolving constraints. We propose Policy Library Control Barrier Function~(PL-CBF), a runtime safety filter that evaluates a library of fallback policies via parallel finite-horizon rollouts, selects the least invasive safe mode, and enforces safety by solving a quadratic program that minimally modifies a nominal policy. We provide a theoretical analysis based on a finite-horizon language metric over closed-loop behaviors, characterizing policy-library coverage requirements for certifying finite-horizon safety. Simulations on a planar double-integrator (4 states), highway driving with abrupt friction changes using a realistic nonlinear vehicle model (8 states), and 3D quadrotor navigation in crowded dynamic environments (12 states) demonstrate improved safety coverage over single-policy safety filters while retaining millisecond-level runtime.

</details>


### [326] [Bayesian Networks for Path-Based Sensors: Gathering Information and Path Planning in Communication Denied Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16673)
*Alkesh K. Srivastava,George P. Kontoudis,Donald Sofge,Michael Otte*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯网络（BN）的路径传感器观测更新方法，用于更有效地融合多路径传感器数据并规划路径以加速信念地图收敛，在单/多机器人静态危险检测任务中优于先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的路径传感器信念更新方法通过平均替代事件历史来近似后验，不够精确。本文希望引入贝叶斯网络来更严谨地建模潜变量与路径观测之间的概率关系，从而提升信念地图的更新质量和收敛速度。

Method: 提出基于贝叶斯网络（BN）的信念更新方法，显式建模潜变量与路径传感器观测之间的概率依赖关系，实现更严格的贝叶斯后验更新；同时结合香农信息论进行路径规划以最大化信息增益。

Result: 在单机器人和多机器人静态危险检测场景下，新方法比先前工作更快地收敛信念地图。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯网络方法为路径传感器融合提供了更严谨的理论框架，能有效提升危险检测等任务中信念地图的收敛效率，适用于通信受限环境。

Abstract: A "path-based sensor" produces a single observation along a continuous path. For example, a boolean path-based sensor returns a single "1" if an event of interest is detected at any point along the path and a "0" otherwise. Notably, a "1" provides no direct information about where along the path the event(s) may have occurred. Previous work has demonstrated that observations from multiple path-based sensors can be fused to create a Bayesian belief map over the spatial locations of the underlying event or phenomenon. Moreover, path planning can employ Shannon information theory to accelerate the rate of convergence of the belief map. In this paper, we present a new method to update the belief map based on a path-based sensor observation, and then plan paths to increase information gain. In contrast to prior work that approximates the posterior by averaging over the alternative event histories, we introduce a Bayesian Network (BN) formulation that models the probabilistic relationships between the latent variables and path-based sensor measurements, enabling a more principled Bayesian belief update. We consider static hazard detection in a communication-denied environment as a representative problem setting. The event of a robot returning from its path corresponds to a path-based hazard sensor reading of "0" (hazard not detected), while a robot failing to return corresponds to a reading of "1" (hazard detected). We consider false positives and false negatives. We find that the new method leads to quicker convergence of the belief map than prior work in both single- and multi-robot cases.

</details>


### [327] [DriveSafer: End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Safety Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16737)
*Shounak Sural,Raj Rajkumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DriveSafer是一个针对端到端生成式自动驾驶规划器的安全框架，通过训练时安全约束和推理时安全引导，在NAVSIM基准上将灾难性失败减少48%，可行驶区域合规失败减少65%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器在安全关键场景中仍存在大量灾难性失败，这些失败源于违反物理约束和安全要求。现有方法主要关注提升平均规划质量，而非针对性减少灾难性规划失败。

Method: 提出DriveSafer框架，包括两个核心组件：1) 训练时的安全约束，将安全要求融入训练过程；2) 推理时的安全引导，在推理阶段引导生成式规划器产生安全行为。

Result: 在NAVSIM基准上，相比SOTA模型DiffusionDrive，灾难性失败(PDMS=0)减少48%，可行驶区域合规失败减少65%以上。

Conclusion: 通过针对性减少灾难性失败而非追求平均性能提升，可以显著改善端到端自动驾驶规划器的安全性。

Abstract: End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving models have shown growing capability in recent years, with performance improving on increasingly challenging benchmarks. However, modern generative E2E planners still suffer from a substantial number of catastrophic failures in safety-critical scenarios. We find that many such failures arise from violations of physical constraints and safety requirements, leading to unsafe behavior. Motivated by this finding, in this paper, we focus on improving safety outcomes in generative end-to-end driving with a targeted reduction of catastrophic planning failures, instead of enhancing average planning quality. Towards this end, we propose DriveSafer, a failure-aware safety framework for end-to-end planners. DriveSafer explicitly steers generative planners towards safe behaviors leveraging both training-time safety constraints and inference-time safety guidance. Compared to the state-of-the-art DiffusionDrive model, on the NAVSIM benchmark, DriveSafer reduces the number of catastrophic failures (PDMS=0) by 48%, with over 65% reduction in drivable-area compliance failures.

</details>


### [328] [LACE: Latent Visual Representation for Cross-Embodiment Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16743)
*Yoo Sung Jang,Kanchana Ranasinghe,Cristina Mata,Yichi Zhang,Jorge Mendez-Mendez,Michael S. Ryoo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LACE通过利用人体和机器人共享身体部位的稀疏对应关系，在自监督学习骨干网络中对齐视觉表征，从而将人类示范数据迁移到机器人策略学习中，显著提升数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督学习骨干网络虽然能编码通用物体的类别语义，但在建立人体与机器人手部视觉对应关系方面表现不佳，导致跨本体学习受限于视觉差异。

Method: 提出LACE框架：1) 利用前向运动学自动获取共享身体部位的对应标注；2) 语义对齐损失将补丁级监督提升到语义级对齐；3) Gram损失保持预训练特征质量。仅需单次机器人示范即可训练模型。

Result: 在零样本迁移中，使用LACE-DINO的策略相比纯DINO性能提升65%；在低数据场景和分布外环境中均有一致性提升。

Conclusion: 通过对齐人体与机器人的视觉表征，可以有效地将丰富的人类示范数据迁移到机器人策略学习，大幅降低对机器人示范数据的需求。

Abstract: Cross-embodiment learning from human demonstrations is hindered by the visual gap between human and robot embodiments. While self-supervised learning (SSL) backbones encode rich inter-class semantics of general objects, we show they fail to establish correspondence between human and robot hands. We propose LACE, a framework that aligns human and robot visual representations in the latent space of these backbones by leveraging correspondences between shared body parts across embodiments as sparse supervision. These annotations can be automatically obtained via forward kinematics, and single robot demonstration is sufficient to train the model. Our semantic alignment loss matches distributions incurred by corresponding features, lifting patch-level supervision to semantic-level alignment, while a Gram loss preserves pretrained feature quality. This alignment enables robot policies to leverage abundant human data when robot demonstrations are scarce: in zero-shot transfer, policies using LACE-DINO outperform those using DINO by a large margin (65\%), with consistent gains in low-data regimes and out-of-distribution environments.

</details>


### [329] ["I'm Not Mad, Just Focused'': Understanding Human Emotions in Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16816)
*Seung Chan Hong,Dana Kulić,Leimin Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的情绪识别系统，相比传统CNN方法，在HRC场景中能更好地理解人类情绪，且用户更喜欢由其驱动的机器人情绪自适应行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HRC中的情绪识别模型依赖表演数据集和单模态输入（如面部表情），难以准确理解真实协作场景中的人类情绪状态。

Method: 提出VLM-based ER系统，利用视觉语言模型的上下文理解能力识别情绪；先在HRC数据集上与人工标注比较语义相似度和情感一致性，再通过服务机器人协作配送任务的用户研究评估效果。

Result: VLM-ER系统在语义相似度和正向情感一致性上均优于CNN基线；用户更偏好由该系统驱动的情绪自适应机器人行为。

Conclusion: VLM凭借上下文理解能力，能有效提升HRC中情绪识别的准确性，情绪自适应机器人行为可改善人机协作体验。

Abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) can benefit from robots' abilities to interpret human emotional states. However, current emotion recognition (ER) models in HRC often fall short, particularly due to their reliance on acted datasets and single-modality inputs like facial expressions. We propose a novel vision language model (VLM)-based ER system that leverages contextual understanding to improve emotion interpretation in HRC. We first evaluate the VLM-ER system by assessing its semantic and sentiment similarity with human annotations on an existing HRC dataset. Then, in a user study with a service robot in a collaborative delivery task, we evaluate the effects of modulating the robot's behaviour based on the user's emotional state inferred by the VLM-ER system. The results show that the proposed VLM-ER system achieves higher semantic similarity and positive sentiment alignment with human annotations compared to a baseline convolutional neural network-based system. Further, participants in the user study preferred emotion-adaptive robot behaviour facilitated by the VLM-ER system.

</details>


### [330] [Pedestrian-Aware LLM-Driven Behavioral Planning for Autonomous Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16858)
*Aidana Baimbetova,Haruki Yonekura,Hamada Rizk,Hirozumi Yamaguchi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动驾驶决策框架，通过将场景观测转化为自然语言推理提示，让LLM推断行人意图、预测风险并生成谨慎的驾驶决策。在SUMO仿真中，零样本下碰撞避免成功率达68%（远超深度强化学习的17.7%），结合少样本情景记忆后提升至96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习(RL)的自动驾驶系统在结构化交通中表现良好，但在行人密集的城市环境中泛化能力差，难以应对训练中未见的异常行人行为。同时，RL依赖手工设计的奖励函数且决策不透明，不适合安全关键场景。

Method: 将结构化场景观测转换为自然语言推理提示，输入LLM进行行人意图推断、风险评估和战术决策生成，再由运动规划器执行平滑可控的轨迹。在SUMO仿真中设置了多种行人交互场景（如乱穿马路、折返、犹豫、双向穿行等），并进行了零样本、少样本（情景记忆）和跨行为泛化评估。

Result: 零样本评估中LLM碰撞避免成功率达68%，远超深度RL基线(17.7%)；单行人场景中结合少样本情景记忆，性能提升至96.0%，超越自定义DQN控制器(82.0%)；跨行为评估中，从折返场景学习的情景记忆可迁移至犹豫场景(82.0%)和双向穿行场景(90.0%)；系统能更早响应、保持更宽安全缓冲，且决策可解释、符合人类直觉。

Conclusion: LLM框架在行人密集的城市自动驾驶中显著优于传统RL方法，具备强大的零样本泛化能力和跨场景迁移能力，同时提供可解释的决策输出，验证了利用LLM的常识推理能力增强自动驾驶安全性的可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) must make reliable decisions in dense urban environments where pedestrian behavior is variable, sometimes abnormal, and often unseen during training. Reinforcement learning (RL)-based AV control systems perform well in structured traffic but struggle to generalize to unpredictable pedestrian interactions and out-of-distribution scenarios. Their reliance on handcrafted rewards and opaque decisions further limits their suitability for safety-critical, pedestrian-rich environments. To address these limitations, we introduce a Large Language Model (LLM)-based decision-making framework for pedestrian-aware behavioral planning. The system converts structured scene observations into natural-language reasoning prompts, enabling the LLM to infer pedestrian intent, anticipate risk, and generate cautious tactical driving decisions. These decisions are executed by a motion planner that ensures smooth, kinematically feasible control. We evaluate the framework in SUMO across multiple pedestrian-interaction scenarios, including unexpected jaywalking, turn-back crossing, hesitation, and bidirectional crossing. In zero-shot evaluation, the LLM-based agent achieves a 68% collision-free success rate, substantially outperforming deep RL baselines (17.7%). With few-shot episodic memory in a single-pedestrian scenario, performance increases to 96.0%, exceeding a custom DQN controller (82.0%). Cross-behavior evaluation further shows that memory derived from turn-back interactions transfers to unseen hesitation and bidirectional crossing scenarios, achieving 82.0% and 90.0% success, respectively. The system consistently initiates earlier responses, maintains wider safety buffers, and produces interpretable, human-aligned decisions.

</details>


### [331] [Plan First, Diffuse Later: Extrinsic Graph Guidance for Long-Horizon Diffusion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16863)
*Yaniv Hassidof,Adir Morgan,Yilun Du,Kiril Solovey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: XDiffuser通过外部搜索（在去噪过程之外）生成状态空间图计划来引导扩散模型，从而有效解决长时序规划中的全局一致性问题，在低质量数据和未见任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合扩散模型在长时序规划中，仅靠局部去噪约束难以保证全局结构的一致性；现有内在搜索方法虽能改善全局性，但计算成本过高。

Method: 提出XDiffuser：先在状态空间图上计算轻量级局部连通性计划（外部搜索），再用该计划引导扩散模型进行单条轨迹的去噪，将探索负担从扩散模型转移到外部搜索。

Result: 在长时序任务上优于扩散基线，尤其在低质量数据场景和未见任务（多智能体协调、TSP推理）上提升显著。

Conclusion: 外部搜索相比内在搜索更高效地实现了长时序规划中的探索，并能在测试时利用经典算法解决未见组合任务。

Abstract: Compositional diffusion models offer a promising route to long-horizon planning by denoising multiple overlapping sub-trajectories while ensuring that together they constitute a global solution. However, enforcing local behavior over long chains is often insufficient for a coherent global structure to emerge. Recent works tackle this limitation through intrinsic search, which explores multiple paths during the denoising process. While intrinsic search improves global coherence, it comes at the cost of repeated evaluations of an already compute-heavy model. In this work, we argue that extrinsic search, performed outside the denoising process, offers a more effective mode of exploration for long-horizon planning while naturally enabling the use of classical algorithms to solve unseen combinatorial tasks at test time. Our eXtrinsic search-guided Diffuser (XDiffuser) first computes a plan over a state-space graph -- serving as a lightweight local connectivity oracle for the diffusion model. The plan is then used to guide denoising for a single trajectory, effectively offloading the burden of exploration. XDiffuser outperforms diffusion-based baselines on long-horizon tasks, with particularly large gains in the low-quality data regime and on unseen tasks beyond goal-reaching, including multi-agent coordination and TSP-style reasoning. Project website: https://yanivhass.github.io/XDiffuser-site/

</details>


### [332] [SSTL: Self-Sensing Tendon Loop for Hysteresis Modeling and Compensation in Tendon-Sheath Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16870)
*Myeongbo Park,Junhyun Park,Ihsan Ullah,Chunggil An,Minho Hwang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出自感知腱环（SSTL）结构，通过在近端同时测量输入输出张力，利用学习映射估计肌腱-鞘机构（TSM）的迟滞参数，实现无需远端传感器的柔性内镜机器人控制补偿，平均RMSE降低88.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 柔性内镜机器人中肌腱-鞘机构（TSM）存在与构型相关的迟滞，导致近端驱动与远端输出之间存在系统性偏差，且该偏差随插入管构型变化，传统补偿方法需远端传感器，增加了系统复杂度和尺寸限制。

Method: 提出Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL)，即双程腱环结构：肌腱从近端经套管到远端滑轮再绕回近端，使得输入和输出张力均可近端测量。利用SSTL与驱动TSM共享同一路径的特性，二者迟滞行为高度相关。通过基于学习的映射从SSTL张力剖面估计驱动TSM的构型相关迟滞参数，并采用前馈控制器进行补偿。

Result: 在三种不同插入管构型下，对正弦和随机轨迹进行实验验证：平均RMSE比未补偿基线降低88.1%，达到直接辨识（需直接测量驱动TSM张力）性能的97.8%。

Conclusion: SSTL通过近端双程张力测量，无需远端传感器即可有效补偿TSM迟滞，显著提升柔性内镜机器人控制精度，且性能接近需直接测量的理想辨识方法。

Abstract: Flexible endoscopic robots enable minimally invasive access through natural orifices, but their control accuracy is limited by configuration-dependent hysteresis in the tendon-sheath mechanisms (TSMs). Tendon-sheath friction and tendon elasticity induce a systematic discrepancy between the proximal actuation input and distal output, and this discrepancy varies with the insertion tube configuration. To address this challenge, this paper proposes the Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL), a double-pass tendon loop routed through the insertion tube and wrapped around a distal pulley, and returned to the proximal end. The loop structure allows both the input and output tensions of the SSTL to be measured proximally, thereby providing an input-output tension profile without requiring distal force or fiber-optic sensors. Because the SSTL shares the same routing path as the actuation TSM, the two TSMs exhibit strongly correlated hysteresis behaviors. From the SSTL tension profile, a learning-based mapping estimates the configuration-dependent hysteresis parameters of the actuation TSM, which are then used by a feedforward controller to compensate for actuation hysteresis. We validate the proposed method by tracking actuation tendon tension under three different insertion tube configurations. Across sinusoidal and random trajectories, the proposed method reduces average RMSE by 88.1% compared with the uncompensated baseline, achieving 97.8% of the performance of direct identification, which requires direct measurement of the input and output tension profile of the actuation TSM.

</details>


### [333] [SADP: Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy for Explainable Robots Learned from Foundation Model Generated Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16871)
*Site Hu,Takato Horii*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出子目标感知扩散策略（SADP），利用基础模型自动生成带子目标标注的演示数据，训练扩散策略以同时理解任务级和子目标级信息，实现可解释且高效的机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习方法仅依赖任务级演示，缺乏子目标结构和执行进度的显式建模；同时标准机器人数据集中子目标级监督稀缺，限制了机器人向用户传达长期操作中当前子任务的能力。

Method: SADP框架：1）利用基础模型自动生成子目标标注的演示数据；2）训练扩散策略，动作生成同时以任务级和子目标级描述为条件；3）设计轻量级辅助头预测子目标完成状态，以暴露执行阶段并监控进度。

Result: 在RLBench仿真和UR5e机器人真实实验中，SADP相比强任务条件扩散基线获得更高任务成功率，同时提供子目标级执行信号用于进度监控和故障诊断。

Conclusion: 内置的可解释性（而非事后解释）可以与高任务性能共存，证明了在机器人学习中将可解释性融入模型设计是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Explainable robots require not only successful task execution but also the ability to expose internal decision-making process in a user-friendly manner. However, most imitation learning methods are trained solely on task-level demonstrations, without explicitly modeling subgoal structure or execution progress. This limitation is further exacerbated by the scarcity of subgoal-level supervision in standard robot learning datasets, which restricts the development of robots that can convey the subtasks they are executing during long-horizon manipulation. To address this issue, this paper proposes Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy (SADP), a framework that leverages foundation models to autonomously generate subgoal-annotated demonstrations and trains diffusion policies on these datasets. SADP structures policy execution around human-interpretable subgoals by conditioning action generation on both task-level and subgoal-level descriptions. A lightweight auxiliary head further predicts subgoal completion states, allowing the robot to expose its current execution stage and monitor subgoal progression. Experiments in RLBench simulations and real-world evaluations on a UR5e robot demonstrate that SADP achieves higher task success rates than strong task-conditioned diffusion baselines, while providing subgoal-level execution signals for monitoring progress and diagnosing failures. These results highlight that built-in, rather than post-hoc, interpretability can coexist with high task performance.

</details>


### [334] [Beyond Safety Filtering: Control Barrier Function-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16894)
*Jianye Xu,Bassam Alrifaee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的奖励设计方法，用于多智能体强化学习（MARL），在自动驾驶交叉口场景中相比启发式奖励方法表现更好，且对超参数不敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习的奖励设计依赖手工设计的启发式规则，难以调优，缺乏对安全约束的明确引导。

Method: 将CBF约束值转化为奖励信号，在MARL中显式引导智能体进行安全学习。

Result: 在四路多车道交叉口场景中，该方法相比两种启发式奖励基线获得最高的任务性能，且对奖励超参数不敏感。

Conclusion: CBF-informed的奖励设计是一种更鲁棒且高效的MARL奖励机制，能够提升安全性和任务表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) uses rewards to guide learning, yet reward design is typically hand-crafted using heuristics that can be difficult to tune. We propose a Control Barrier Function (CBF)-informed reward design for Multi-Agent RL (MARL) that converts CBF constraint values under joint MARL actions into a reward signal that explicitly guides safe learning. We compare against two heuristic reward baselines in a four-way multi-lane intersection with connected and automated vehicles. Results show that our method achieves the highest task performance and is less sensitive to reward hyperparameters, yielding consistently strong performance across the tested hyperparameter range. Code for reproducing the experimental results and a video demonstration are available at https://github.com/bassamlab/SigmaRL.

</details>


### [335] [MORN: Metacognitive Object-Goal Regulation for Resource-Rational Long-Horizon Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16932)
*Xi Lin,Jiayi Li,Kangyi Wu,Jiaqiao Tang,Qingrong He,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MORN架构，基于双过程理论为导航智能体注入元认知能力，通过监控全局资源动态调节目标调度，有效缓解因局部观测导致的资源浪费问题，在HM3D数据集上将目标完成率从0.23提升至0.30，浪费步数比从0.90降至0.70。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的ObjectNav智能体仅作为纯反应式系统运行，缺乏全局资源感知能力，在长时域任务中常因部分可观测性将关键预算（如时间、电量）浪费在不可行的子目标上，无法平衡局部探索与全局任务可行性。

Method: 提出MORN（元认知目标调控导航）架构，受认知科学中双过程理论启发，在冻结的导航主干上增加一个System 2元控制器，持续监控System 1运动执行器。通过形式化三个神经认知状态——潜力指数、持久门控和证据累积——基于实时进度速度与感知不确定性动态调控任务调度，从而消除沉没成本谬误。

Result: 在HM3D数据集上，MORN将目标完成率从0.23提升至0.30（提升约30%），将浪费步数比从0.90降低至0.70（降低约22%）。

Conclusion: 在资源受限的自主系统中，对全局资源的元认知意识与反应式导航能力同等重要；MORN证明了通过认知启发的架构设计可以有效提升智能体在长时域任务中的资源效率与任务完成率。

Abstract: Robots deployed in unstructured human environments must frequently execute long-horizon missions, such as find the mug, then the chair, then the printer, under strict operational constraints. While contemporary zero-shot Object Navigation (ObjectNav) agents leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to effectively localize semantic targets, they operate as purely reactive systems that inherently lack global resource awareness. Consequently, these agents inadvertently exhaust critical budgets, including time and battery, on infeasible subgoals due to partial observability, failing to balance local exploration with global mission viability. To bridge this gap by injecting resource-rationality into the navigation loop, we present MORN (Metacognitive Object-goal Regulation Navigation), an executive architecture inspired by Dual-Process Theory in cognitive science. MORN augments frozen navigation backbones with a System 2 meta-controller that continuously monitors the System 1 locomotor. By formalizing three neuro-cognitive states, Potentiality Index, Persistence Gating, and Evidence Accumulation, MORN dynamically regulates the mission schedule based on online estimates of progress velocity and perceptual uncertainty. This mechanism effectively neutralizes the Sunk Cost Fallacy, enabling agents to abort zombie goals early and decisively commit to achievable ones. Extensive experiments on the HM3D dataset demonstrate that MORN improves Goal Completion Rate (CR) from 0.23 to 0.30 and reduces Wasted Step Fraction (WSF) from 0.90 to 0.70, establishing that in resource-constrained autonomy, the metacognitive awareness of global resources is as critical as the reactive ability to navigate.

</details>


### [336] [NORM-Nav: Zero-Shot Mobile Robot Navigation with Natural Language Behavioral Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16979)
*Dongjie Huo,Junhui Wang,Chao Gao,Yan Qiao,Dong Zhang,Guyue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: NORM-Nav是一个零样本框架，利用LLM解析自然语言行为约束，通过多层级成本图（几何、语义、方向、速度）集成到传统成本图导航中，使移动机器人在人类环境中生成符合社会规范的轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于成本图的导航只关注几何可行性，忽略了人类环境中的行为惯例，导致社交不适当的行为。

Method: NORM-Nav：零样本框架。LLM将自然语言指令解析为结构化约束，通过实时视觉-激光雷达感知进行grounding，编码为多层成本图（几何、语义、方向、速度线索），与标准网格规划器兼容。

Result: 仿真和真实实验表明，NORM-Nav相比基线方法提高了任务成功率，生成的轨迹更接近人类参考轨迹。

Conclusion: 将自然语言行为约束通过LLM解析并编码为多层成本图，能有效提升移动机器人在人机共融环境中的社交导航性能。

Abstract: Mobile robots operating in human-centered environments must generate not only collision-free paths but also trajectories that follow local behavioral conventions. Conventional costmap-based navigation emphasizes geometric feasibility and often overlooks such requirements, which can result in socially inappropriate behaviors. This paper presents NORM-Nav, a zero-shot framework that integrates natural language behavioral constraints into costmap-based planning. An LLM parses each instruction into structured constraints and grounds them using real-time vision--LiDAR perception. These constraints are encoded as multi-layer costmaps that represent geometric, semantic, directional, and velocity cues and are directly compatible with standard grid-based planners. Simulation and real-world experiments indicate that NORM-Nav improves task success rates and produces trajectories closer to human references than representative baselines. The project website is available at https://ei-nav.github.io/NORM-Nav.

</details>


### [337] [Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation with Symmetry Annotation-Free Learning Strategy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17033)
*Wenxiao Chen,Xueyu Yuan,Liu Liu,Di Wu,Dan Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SAFAG提出了一种无需对称标注的框架，通过两阶段逐步细化和自监督学习策略，实现了通用可操作部件（GAPart）的姿态估计，在数据稀缺场景下表现优越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GAPart姿态估计方法要么对称性问题设计不足，要么需要大量对称性标注，这在数据稀缺场景下严重阻碍了精确估计。

Method: 提出SAFAG框架：1）两阶段逐步精炼（candidate-to-final）的四元数回归；2）将对称性预测视为概率分布问题，采用自监督学习策略进行求解。

Result: 实验结果表明SAFAG在性能和鲁棒性上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 该工作有望广泛应用于具身智能系统的多个领域。

Abstract: Urgently needed generalizable robot object interaction and manipulation requires high-quality Cross-Category object perception. As a pioneer of this area, Generalizable and Actionable Parts (GAParts) understanding has attracted increasing attention from relevant researchers. However, most recent works either have insufficient design regarding the symmetry issue or require rich symmetry annotation, which severely impedes precise GAPart pose estimation in data-lacking scenarios. In this paper, we propose SAFAG, a novel Symmetry Annotation-Free framework for Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation. Specifically, we suggest a stepwise refinement two-stage framework for candidate-to-final quaternion regression, and tackle the symmetry prediction as a probability distribution problem with self-supervised learning strategy. The experimental results demonstrate the superior performance and robustness of our SAFAG. We believe that our work has the enormous potential to be applied in many areas of embodied AI system.

</details>


### [338] [How to Instruct Your Robot: Dense Language Annotations Power Robot Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17077)
*Bosung Kim,Ruiyi Wang,David Acuna,Jaehun Jung,Alexander Trevithick,Brandon Cui,Yejin Choi,Prithviraj Ammanabrolu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DeMiAn方法，通过密集多维度语言标注（物理运动、场景组成、手臂姿态、推理）对现有机器人演示和第一人称视频数据进行重标注，在不收集新数据的情况下提升策略学习效果，在100万条机器人操作数据和5万条人类视频数据上验证有效，将语言密度作为机器人政策学习的实用扩展杠杆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 收集机器人演示数据的成本高昂，而语言标注相对便宜；现有方法未能充分利用语言标注的密度来从固定数据集中提取更多信号。

Method: 两阶段方法：1) 使用VLM对演示片段进行四维度（物理运动、场景组成、手臂姿态、推理）密集标注；2) 训练一个"讲师"模型，根据任务描述和初始场景快照，在部署时选择最适合当前任务的标注类型（异步运行以隐藏延迟）。

Result: 在100万机器人操作视频和5万EgoVerse人类视频上，DeMiAn同时提升VLA策略和视频基础的世界动作模型。RoboCasa上成功率比任务基线高5%，仅比任务级Oracle低3%。无单一标注维度在所有任务上占优。同时提升复合任务和分布外性能，在计算性能前沿上表现更优。

Conclusion: 密集重标注是机器人策略学习的一个实用扩展杠杆，无需收集新演示数据即可提升性能，且选择合适的密集语言标注至关重要。

Abstract: Scaling robot policy learning is bottlenecked by the cost of collecting demonstrations, while language annotations for existing demonstrations are comparatively cheap. We study language density as a lever for extracting more signal from a fixed robot or egocentric-video corpus. We introduce DeMiAn (Dense Multi-aspect Annotation), a two-stage approach that first re-labels demonstration segments with VLM-generated annotations along four complementary aspects: physical motion, scene composition, arm pose, and reasoning. A learned instructor then maps a task description and initial scene snapshot to a task-appropriate annotation at deployment, running asynchronously so generation latency is hidden behind policy execution. Across over 1M robot manipulation clips and 50K EgoVerse human-egocentric videos, DeMiAn improves both a vision-language-action policy and a video-based world-action model without collecting new demonstrations. On RoboCasa, the instructor raises success by 5 points over a task-only baseline and comes within 3 points of a per-task oracle. No fixed annotation aspect dominates across tasks, showing that selecting the right dense language matters. DeMiAn also improves composite-task and out-of-distribution performance, and shifts the compute-performance frontier in both mid-training and post-training after accounting for annotation-generation FLOPs. These results position dense re-annotation as a practical scaling lever for robot policy learning.

</details>


### [339] [Contrastive Conceptor Activation Steering (COAST): Unlocking Vision-Language-Action Models through Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17144)
*Miranda Muqing Miao,Subin Kim,Brandon Yang,Lyle Ungar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: COAST 通过概念器（conceptor）识别成功关键子空间，在推理时引导 VLA 潜变量向这些子空间偏移，无需训练即可显著提升任务成功率（仿真+20%，真实机器人+40%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型虽然继承了 VLM 强大的感知先验，但在实际机器人任务中表现脆弱，频繁失败。现有方法难以轻量级地利用 VLA 内部已有的任务相关知识。

Method: 提出 COAST：利用概念器（conceptor）从少量成功/失败轨迹中学习线性算子，识别任务关键子空间；推理时通过激活引导（activation steering）将 VLA 潜变量向该子空间偏移。

Result: 在三种架构（flow-matching VLA、自回归 VLA、Diffusion Policy）上，绝对平均任务成功率提升仿真>20%，真实机器人>40%。失败模式跨任务共享结构，可迁移使用已拟合的概念器。

Conclusion: 当前 VLA 的潜表示中仍保留大量任务相关知识，失败源于动作解码器的瓶颈；通过轻量级、无需训练的潜空间引导，可有效解锁这些能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage powerful perceptual priors from web-scale Vision-Language Model (VLM) pre-training, yet they remain surprisingly brittle in practice, frequently failing at simple robotic tasks. To mitigate this, we propose Contrastive Conceptor Activation Steering (COAST). COAST builds on the notion of a "conceptor", a linear operator that soft-projects data into the principal components of a target distribution. COAST uses conceptors to identify success-critical subspaces for a target robotic task from a few examples of success and failure rollouts. At inference time, it steers VLA latents into these identified success subspaces to improve task outcomes. Across three architecturally distinct neural policies (flow-matching VLA, autoregressive VLA, and Diffusion Policy), COAST improves absolute mean simulation and real-robot task success rate by over 20 and 40% respectively. The activation subspace geometry reveals that failure modes share substantial structure across tasks while success representations remain largely task-specific. When tasks share similar failure modes, this structure enables previously fitted conceptors to improve performance on new tasks without refitting. Ultimately, our results suggest that current VLAs retain substantial task-relevant knowledge in their latent representations, and that the action expert's decoding bottleneck could be mitigated by steering its residual stream toward task-relevant subspaces. COAST provides a lightweight, training-free path to unlocking these latent capabilities by steering the model towards its own "success" distributions.

</details>


### [340] [Event-Grounded Sparse Autoencoders for Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17204)
*Xinchen Jin,Aditya Chatterjee,Pranav Kumar,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于事件的VLA可解释性分析管道，将SAE特征锚定到行为关键事件上，而非文本上下文，从而在闭环行为层面实现VLA策略的因果分析，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语言和视觉模型的机械可解释性工具无法直接迁移到VLA策略上，因为VLA输出的是机器人动作而非人类可读的token，且干预测试需要昂贵的闭环 rollout，缺乏行为锚定的可解释性分析方法。

Method: 提出事件锚定的可解释性管道：在任务内对末端执行器关键帧进行聚类（利用视觉、状态和时序线索），将SAE特征关联到行为关键事件，并可结合VLM进行语义标注；通过事件排序来评估因果效应。

Result: 在两种仿真架构和真实机器人实验中，事件锚定排序在OpenVLA上产生了最强的因果效应，并成功迁移到π0.5的连续动作切片上；SAE作为干预基础虽有效但存在稀疏性和架构/干预位置的差异性，激进干预暴露了安全性和可解释性的极限。

Conclusion: 事件锚定的SAE分析是行为导向的VLA可解释性的实用起点，未来需探索超越动作对齐坐标的SAE特征、更细粒度的闭环评估以及高风险部署中的安全干预方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies translate language and visual inputs into robot actions, where their hidden representations directly shape closed-loop behavior. However, mechanistic interpretability tools from language and vision-language models do not transfer cleanly to VLAs: outputs are robot actions rather than human-readable tokens, and interventions can only be tested via expensive closed-loop rollouts. We propose an event-grounded interpretability pipeline that anchors SAE feature analysis to behavioral events rather than text contexts. End-effector keyframes are clustered within each task using visual, state, and temporal cues, linking SAE features to behaviorally salient events and, via optional VLM annotations, to semantic context. To our knowledge, our pipeline is among the first to ground SAE-based VLA analysis in closed-loop behavioral events. Across two simulation architectures and a real-robot study, event-grounded ranking yields the strongest causal effects on OpenVLA and transfers to the continuous action chunks of $π_{0.5}$. SAE is a sparse but imperfect intervention basis: usability varies with architecture and intervention site, and aggressive intervention reveals safety and interpretability limits. Overall, event-grounded SAE analysis emerges as a practical starting point for behavior-anchored VLA interpretability, motivating future work on SAE features beyond action-aligned coordinates, finer-grained closed-loop evaluation, and safe interventions for high-stakes VLA deployments. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/xc-j/Event-SAE}.

</details>


### [341] [Generating Realistic Safety-Critical Scenarios for Vehicle-Pedestrian Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17229)
*Qingwen Pu,Kun Xie,Yuan Zhu,Guocong Zhai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出三阶段框架，结合真实世界数据和自适应仿真，生成行为逼真的安全关键场景。通过MA-SST-DDPG模型在真实数据中预训练、在CARLA仿真中强化学习，最终生成含198,000+交互片段的VPSCI数据集。模型在轨迹误差（ADE=0.072m，FDE=0.142m）上优于基线，图灵测试证明生成行为与真实数据不可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统部署需要严格验证车辆-行人安全关键交互，但真实数据集很少捕获高风险场景，而仿真平台缺乏逼真的行为模型。

Method: 三阶段框架：1) 使用真实安全关键数据预训练MA-SST-DDPG多智能体；2) 在CARLA仿真中在线强化学习以泛化至多样场景；3) 使用精炼模型生成大规模VPSCI数据集。

Result: 精炼MA-SST-DDPG模型在轨迹误差上最优（ADE=0.072m, FDE=0.142m）；统计检验证实生成数据与真实数据在冲突严重性和行为响应上分布等价；图灵测试表明生成行为与真实交互不可区分。

Conclusion: 该框架能高效生成高保真安全关键数据，为自动驾驶系统开发和基于仿真的安全评估提供宝贵资源。

Abstract: Automated driving system deployment requires rigorous validation across safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian interactions, yet real-world datasets rarely capture high-risk scenarios while simulation platforms lack realistic behavior. In response, this study proposes a three-stage framework that combines real-world grounding with adaptive simulation to generate behaviorally realistic safety-critical scenarios at scale. Stage 1 pre-trains multi-agent state-space Transformer-enhanced DDPG (MA-SST-DDPG) agents on real-world safety-critical data to learn human-like interactive evasive behaviors through data-driven learning. Stage 2 deploys pre-trained multi-agents in CARLA for online reinforcement learning to generalize across diverse scenarios, integrating real-world knowledge with simulation experience to produce a refined MA-SST-DDPG model. Stage 3 uses CARLA with the refined model to generate over 198,000 high-resolution interaction episodes from eight intersection scenarios, culminating in the Vehicle-Pedestrian Safety-Critical Interaction (VPSCI) dataset. The Refined MA-SST-DDPG model outperformed baseline methods in reproducing realistic evasive behaviors, achieving the lowest trajectory errors (ADE = 0.072 m, FDE = 0.142 m). Statistical comparison confirmed distributional equivalence between the generated and real-world data in both conflict severity and behavioral response. A Turing test confirmed that the three-stage framework generated evasive behaviors were indistinguishable from real-world interactions. These results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in producing high-fidelity safety-critical data, offering valuable sources for the development of ADS and simulation-based safety evaluations.

</details>


### [342] [SEDualVLN: A Spatially-Enhanced Dual-System for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17249)
*Jingzhi Huang,Junkai Huang,Wenxuan Song,Haoyang Yang,Hailong Huang,Haoang Li,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SEDualVLN双系统框架，结合空间增强的VLM（System 1，快速行动生成）和MLLM+地图模块（System 2，慢速路径规划），通过快慢协同在VLN-CE任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端VLN方法缺乏长程导航和动态推理能力，而零样本模块化方法空间定位有限且推理耗时；亟需一种兼顾高效行动与可靠规划的导航框架。

Method: 构建双系统框架：System 1为增强全局与局部空间感知的VLM，用于快速动作生成；System 2集成通用MLLM与建图模块，通过3D地图俯视图和渲染路径图像进行路径点规划。两者通过快慢协调机制协同完成导航。

Result: 在VLN-CE基准上达到最先进水平，消融实验验证了各系统和模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 双系统快慢协同范式能有效结合VLM的高效行动与MLLM的深度规划能力，为VLN任务提供了兼顾效率与鲁棒性的新路径。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) approaches have currently followed two primary paradigms: the end-to-end Vision-Language Model (VLM) policy fine-tuned on navigation trajectories to directly predict actions, and the zero-shot modular pipeline integrating pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for training-free generalization to unseen environments. However, end-to-end methods struggle with long-horizon navigation and lack dynamic reasoning, whereas zero-shot methods are constrained by limited spatial grounding for reliable planning and also require substantial reasoning time.
